jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager - B2B SaaS (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei epilot gestaltest du direkt mit, wie über 200 Energieunternehmen ihre Produkte digitalisieren – von der Netzanschluss-Anfrage, über die Photovoltaikanlage bis hin zum Stromtarif. Wir suchen einen Product Manager mit echtem Product Mindset und dem Hunger, etwas aufzubauen – ob du dich "Senior" nennst oder nicht, ist uns dabei egal. Was zählt: wie du denkst, wie du entscheidest und wie ambitioniert du an deine Arbeit herangehst. Du verantwortest einen zentralen Produktbereich, arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Design zusammen und bringst datengetriebene Entscheidungen auf die Roadmap. Kein Konzernumfeld, kein endloser Abstimmungsmarathon – sondern echter Gestaltungsraum in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden SaaS-Scale-Ups der Energiewirtschaft.

epilot digitalisiert die Energiewirtschaft mit einer einzigartigen Cloud-Software. Wir sind ein wachsendes Scale-Up im Herzen von Köln. Unsere Mission: epilot revolutioniert die Zusammenarbeit aller Marktpartner, die in der Energiewelt zur Erbringung von Produkten und Dienstleistungen zusammenarbeiten. Wir bieten innerhalb der Cloudwelt ein großes Netzwerk aus Partnern, welches durch die Community ständig erweitert wird.


Das erwartet dich

  • Verantwortung deines Produktbereichs von der Strategie bis zur Auslieferung – mit voller Ownership über Discovery, Roadmap und Ergebnis.

  • Du arbeitest täglich eng mit einem cross-funktionalen Team aus Engineers und Designern zusammen und schaffst klare Prioritäten.

  • Übersetzung von Kunden-Feedback, Marktanalysen und Business-Ziele in konkrete Features – und du weißt, wann du etwas weglassen musst.

  • Du nutzt deine starken analytischen Fähigkeiten und dein tiefes Verständnis für unsere Kund:innen, um unser Produkt im Markt strategisch auszurichten und zu differenzieren.

  • Du triffst smarte Entscheidungen basierend auf der Auswertung von KPI’s, sowie Kunden- und Marktanalysen.

  • Hands-on im Code: Kleine PRs, Konfigurationsänderungen oder das direkte Testen im Code sind für dich kein Tabu – du verstehst, was unter der Haube passiert, und das macht dich zu einem besseren PM.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du denkst wie ein Entrepreneur – du verstehst unsere Business-Ziele und wie deine täglichen Entscheidungen diese beeinflussen.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge: Features oder Produkte, die du von der Idee bis zum Launch verantwortet hast und auf deren Wirkung du stolz bist.

  • Kommunikationsstärke gegenüber verschiedenen Stakeholdern: u.a. Engineers, Sales, Geschäftsführung & Kund:innen.

  • Auf sich ändernde Bedingungen und Anforderungen reagierst du schnell, hast eine starke Do-it Mentalität und bist ein Mensch, der Unkonventionelles mag.

  • Deine kreative Denkweise ermöglicht es dir, innovative Lösungen für komplexe Probleme zu finden und Features zu konzipieren, die im Markt gebraucht werden.

  • Du bist ein TEAM-Player, motivierst und begeisterst deine Leute, um gemeinsam die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen.

  • AI-Tools nutzt du aktiv in deiner täglichen Arbeit – sei es für Research, Prototyping, Datenanalyse oder das Schärfen von Anforderungen – und weißt, wie du sie sinnvoll in den PM-Prozess integrierst.

  • Du hast Erfahrungen mit den gängigen Tools des digitalen Projekt- und Produktmanagements, z.B. Jira, Figma, Miro, Power-BI o.ä. und agile Arbeitsweisen (Scrum/Kanban) liegen dir.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Sprache und Schrift.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Ein Produkt mit echtem Impact: Unsere Plattform beschleunigt die Energiewende – du siehst, wofür du arbeitest.

  • Start-up-Mentalität: dynamische Atmosphäre und großartiger Teamspirit.

  • AI-first Arbeitsweise: Wir setzen aktiv auf AI-Tools im Produkt- und Arbeitsalltag – von der Discovery bis zur Dokumentation – und geben dir den Freiraum, neue Werkzeuge auszuprobieren und einzuführen.

  • Ein stark wachsendes Unternehmen mit offener Kommunikationskultur, motivierten Kolleg:innen, und internationaler Unternehmenskultur

  • Exponentielle Lernkurve – epilot wächst rasant, selbiges erwarten wir von dir

  • Einen zentralen und modernen Standort im Herzen von Köln mit coolen Cafés direkt um die Ecke

  • Transparenz – Wir pflegen eine sehr flache und offene Unternehmenskultur, alles ist einsehbar und steht zur Diskussion.

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents wie bspw. zu Karneval, das Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, Company breakfast und noch viel mehr Gelegenheiten deine epilot:innen auch außerhalb der Arbeitszeiten kennenzulernen

  • Die Möglichkeit für mobiles, flexibles Arbeiten, Sportangebote (u.a. Urban Sports Club) u.v.m

Immer noch nicht überzeugt? Hier unser Versprechen an alle zukünftigen epilot:innen: promise.epilot.cloud

jobs.title: Product Manager (Freelance)
Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
What we're building

Jiga is on a mission to help engineers build physical products faster.

The problem: engineers designing physical products waste weeks chasing quotes, vetting suppliers, and managing procurement instead of actually engineering. Jiga fixes this by connecting engineers directly with vetted manufacturers (CNC, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing). Think "npm install for mechanical engineers" - get the parts you need without the admin nightmare.

We're a small, fully-funded, cashflow-positive team serving enterprise customers like NASA, Google, Tesla, and Apple.

The role

We're looking for an execution-focused, zero-fluff Staff Product Manager. Someone who can take ownership and drive product initiatives with a high degree of autonomy. You'll be making calls on what we build and why, translating messy customer and operational problems into simple solutions, and making sure they're executed well, monitored, and improved over time.

How we actually work

We’re a small remote team made up of the best of the best. Our team members are distributed around the globe, with product and engineering talent across Europe, Israel, and the US. You’ll also work with teammates in Asia. Most of our work happens async, which is the secret sauce of our success.

High trust, low bullshit: We don't count hours or peek over your shoulder on Slack. We trust you to get your work done and tell us when something's wrong. You'll have real ownership over what you build, no process theater, no busy-work meetings.

Question everything: See something that doesn't make sense? Say it. Have a better way to do something? Just do it. We actually mean it when we say we want people to challenge the status quo and improve things. Our internal motto is “Don’t drink the kool-aid.”

No busy work, no fluff: We keep processes lightweight and practical. If something helps us work better or solve a real problem, we do it. If it creates work without adding value, we question it.

Actually friendly, not corporate friendly: We play games online every week (current favorite: Make it Meme). Once a year we fly everyone somewhere beautiful for our offsite. We genuinely like hanging out together, which turns out to be way better than forced "team building exercises."

What we value in product and engineering:

Simple > Complicated. Simple code, simple architecture. Simple solutions are better than complex ones.

Ship it, then improve it. Perfection is the enemy of done. Launch now, iterate forever.

Product > Engineering. Every line of code should make our users' lives better. We're not here to show off our algorithmic prowess - we're here to solve real business problems.

Financials

Jiga is fully funded, cashflow positive, with growing revenue MoM. We're completely transparent about our runway and finances - ask us anything.

What you'll actually do

  • Talk to customers and suppliers, and work closely with internal users to understand their workflows and pain points (not just read reports about them).

  • Go deep into a complex problem and come back with a simple solution.

  • Analyze and monitor product usage data yourself to inform decisions and measure results.

  • Define what we build next and why, then write specs engineers can actually execute on.

  • Work closely with engineering and design to take solutions through delivery, follow up after launch, and improve what isn’t working.

  • Collaborate with sales, CS, and operations to understand business needs and improve internal processes.

  • Take ownership and move things forward independently without exhausting approval loops.

  • Clearly communicate what we’re not focusing on and why.

  • Use AI throughout all of the above to move faster, go deeper, and get more done.

What we're looking for

Must have:

  • You've built meaningful products that people use and that drive business results.

  • 5+ years in product, including experience owning complex initiatives independently.

  • Startup experience (<50 people). You know what “do everything” means.

  • Actually hands-on: you've done user research, written specs, built prototypes, and prioritized backlogs yourself. Recently. Not five years ago before you “moved to strategy.”

  • Comfortable with data, dashboards, and product analytics. You ask the right questions, find the answers yourself, and question what the numbers are telling you.

  • You know what moves the needle, focus on that, and separate real problems from noise.

  • You go deep with engineers, communicate clearly in writing, keep stakeholders aligned, and ask users questions that uncover real needs.

  • You're willing and able to get into operational details, work with internal teams, and improve how things get done.

  • You use AI hands-on in your daily work and have experience building AI-powered features that deliver real value within users’ workflows.

  • Strong UI/UX instincts. You have opinions about the details.

  • At least 4 hours of overlap with GMT+3 working hours.

Nice to have:

  • A background in industrial design, mechanical engineering, or supply chain.

  • Hands-on experience as a software engineer, data analyst, or UI/UX designer.

  • B2B experience in collaboration tools, quoting, supply chain, manufacturing, CAD, logistics, or marketplaces.

You'll love it here if

  • You're energized by ambiguity, not paralyzed by it. "Figure it out" sounds like freedom, not abandonment.

  • You have strong opinions loosely held. You're decisive but update quickly when you're wrong.

  • You're low-ego, high-output. You do the grunt work, not just the strategy decks.

  • You see gaps and fill them without being asked.

  • You say what you think. No corporate speak, no hedging, no "let's circle back."

  • "If I can solve this without pulling in a dev, I'll just do it" is how you operate.

  • You're obsessively curious about manufacturing and how things get made.

This might not be for you if

  • You need meetings to get things moving.

  • You prefer clear requirements handed to you.

  • You like building consensus before making any decision.

  • "Move fast and break things" gives you anxiety.

  • You want to focus on "strategy" and have someone else handle the details.

  • You can’t operate without a clear process and hierarchy.

What we offer

  • A small team where you matter: We never compromise on people. That means you are part of the best team in the world.

  • Zero bureaucracy: We hate process theatre as much as you do.

  • Real ownership and responsibility: Make decisions, ship solutions, own the outcomes.

  • Complete flexibility: Work from anywhere, set your own hours, take time off when you need it (parents especially welcome).

  • Genuinely high trust: We trust you to do great work and be honest when things go sideways.

  • A team that actually likes each other: International, diverse, genuinely friendly people who enjoy working together.

  • Generous stock options: Meaningful equity in the company you’re helping build.

  • Self-development budget for books, courses, conferences, whatever helps you grow.

  • Annual offsites in beautiful places.

  • Fast-paced environment with tons of creative freedom.

  • Hard, interesting problems with a team that's positioned to win big.

How to apply

Tell us about a product decision you made that was controversial at the time but turned out right. And one that turned out wrong.

jobs.title: Digital CS Program Manager
jobs.description:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of customers, most of our customer base, work with Rentman without a dedicated Customer Success Manager. They sign up, set up Rentman and get to work, but not all of them get the most out of what they pay for, and today we mostly help them when they reach out to us. We want to change that. Your job is to make sure every one of them gets the most out of what they pay for, starting with new customers in their first months. Instead of adding CSMs at the same rate as we grow, we’re building a system of signals, plays and AI agents that helps these customers adopt Rentman, stay and grow with us. However, a human touch always stays: our pooled CSMs step in at the moments where a person makes the difference.

This is a new role and a new function, and you start as a team of one. You’ll build Digital CS from the start, with support from Data, Ops and AI engineering and a direct report to our Head of CX. There’s room to shape how AI agents are used in Customer Success, and a growth path towards CS or Revenue Operations.

What you'll do

  • Explore product usage, engagement, billing and support data in BigQuery to find which behaviour predicts adoption, churn or contraction. Turn those signals into trigger rules: what counts, from which threshold, at what moment and for which customer group. You build the data models behind these signals yourself, with our Data team reviewing your work.

  • Build automated plays across email and in-app messaging in tools like HubSpot and Chameleon, starting with new customers who haven’t adopted the product yet. You also automate the processes around your plays yourself, including AI steps. Every play defines when a customer goes to a pooled CSM, for example when there’s a cancellation signal or no response to the automated steps.

  • Every play runs against a control group. Ship a small version first, measure whether the effect is real or noise, improve what works and stop what doesn’t.

  • Write and maintain the customer communication for your plays across email, in-app and agent instructions, in language that fits our brand.

  • Shape agent specs and prompts that AI engineering builds from: tasks, rules, examples and when to hand over to a person. Define test cases and quality criteria, and check the agent’s work every week the way you would a team member’s.

  • Work with the onboarding squad, Content & Community, Product Marketing and RevOps so plays fit their designs and don’t clash with launches or product tours, and help decide which CS tools we build on.

Your first year

  • First 3 months: you find the first signals and set baselines together with our Data team.

  • After 4 months: your first plays for new customers are live, each running against a control group.

  • By the end of your first year: around 8 plays are live, at least 5 of them with a proven effect, and you’ve run a first pilot with an AI agent.

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years driving scaled adoption or retention for a large customer base, for example in scaled or digital Customer Success, CS or Revenue Operations, lifecycle or CRM marketing, or growth, at a SaaS or subscription business.

  • Proven experience turning product usage data into health scores, signals or lifecycle triggers.

  • A track record of one-to-many programs with results you can show in numbers, including how you knew the change came from the program and not something else.

  • No need to wait for an admin: you build workflows and sequences yourself in tools like HubSpot, or Chameleon.

  • Solid SQL skills: you write and read it independently.

Nice to haves

  • You’ve built a CS program or function from scratch (0 to 1), not only taken one over.

  • Hands-on work with agent specs or AI-supported workflows in a CS or support setting, and using AI daily for writing, analysis and testing while knowing its limits: wrong answers, privacy, and when a person has to step in.

  • A background in the live event, AV or equipment rental industry.

  • Experience in Git and pull requests

What you’ll get

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

  • A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

  • Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

  • A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

  • Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

  • Pension plan through BrightPensioen

  • An annual training budget to grow your skills

  • Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth

  • Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac

  • Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership

  • An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office

  • An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team

  • A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

  • An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Our process

Here's a breakdown of our recruitment process to give you a clear idea:

  • Introduction call with the recruiter about the job & Rentman, online (30 mins)

  • Initial conversation with the hiring manager, online (30 mins)

  • Past Experience & Culture interview with the team, online (60 mins)

  • Take-home assignment (max 120 mins)

  • Final Skills interview incl. case presentation, on-site (90 mins)


Apply now! For questions or additional information, contact us at

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Platform Experience (all genders)
jobs.description:
JustPlay is looking for a Senior Product Manager - Platform Experience to join our Meta product domain and help shape a seamless, engaging experience that connects our games with the broader JustPlay platform.

At JustPlay, Meta is the layer between core gameplay and our rewards platform - including progress, rewards, boosters, LiveOps, and the experiences that connect each game to the wider JustPlay ecosystem. The Meta team owns this layer across our full game portfolio, extending platform features into games and building shared, reusable components that can be adopted across multiple titles. This helps us create a consistent player experience and scale new features across the portfolio without rebuilding them game by game.

In this role, you'll focus on making the JustPlay ecosystem feel seamless for players - identifying where the experience breaks between games and platform, turning those gaps into product opportunities, and setting direction around the solutions that can have the greatest impact on our key metrics. You'll work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and game teams to align around priorities, make trade-offs, and drive outcomes across the ecosystem.

What sets this role apart?

You'll be building for an entire portfolio of 50+ games, not just a single title. That means thinking in systems, balancing the needs of different games and player journeys, and shaping solutions that can scale across the JustPlay ecosystem.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy, priorities, and key results for your area within the Meta domain

  • Identify and prioritise high-impact opportunities across the JustPlay ecosystem, balancing player needs, business goals, and technical constraints.

  • Drive complex product problems with a high degree of autonomy, from identifying the opportunity through launch, measurement, and iteration

  • Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, Data game teams, and other Product team members to shape solutions, align on priorities, and bring impactful features to life.

  • Translate player needs, business goals, and product insights into clear product priorities and solutions

  • Manage priorities and trade-offs across multiple initiatives while keeping teams aligned on goals and outcomes

  • Design and run experiments to validate hypotheses, measure impact, and continuously improve the product

  • Contribute to a strong feedback culture by sharing perspectives openly, challenging ideas constructively, and actively giving and receiving feedback across the Product team

     

Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience within mobile or another B2C digital product, ideally with exposure to mobile games, gamification, loyalty, or rewards products.

  • Proven experience owning a product area or domain, including strategy, prioritization, key results, and measurable outcomes

  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience using data to make product decisions and evaluate impact

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, particularly Engineering, Design, and Data

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn complex challenges into clear product solutions

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, balancing priorities and adapting as new information emerges

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Comfortable giving and receiving direct feedback and contributing openly within the Product team

  • Excellent English communication skills

Job Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Everyone's welcome here
At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.
We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. If you don't meet every requirement in this ad, apply anyway. We know great candidates don’t always tick every box and some of our best hires didn't either. We are looking forward to your application!

Product Manager Insurance P&C
jobs.description:
Insify is looking for a smart, ambitious and relentlessly driven Insurance Product Manager to join our team. In this role you’ll be a driving force behind our product expansions and building the digital platform for SME insurance. A rare opportunity to take real ownership in a fast-scaling European insurtech and shape outcomes that matter.

At Insify, we build insurance for entrepreneurs because we are entrepreneurs ourselves. We know what it’s like to build something from scratch, to take risks, and to carry responsibility that doesn’t switch off at 5 pm.

Our mission is simple but ambitious: to make business insurance 10x simpler, faster, and fairer for entrepreneurs and SMEs across Europe. No paperwork. No fine print. No legacy complexity. Just modern software, smart automation, and a relentless focus on the customer.

We are a high-growth European scale-up, backed by €43M from world-class investors, on a mission to become a global leader in digital insurance for entrepreneurs and SMEs. Starting in the Netherlands, we’ve expanded into France and Germany, and we’re only accelerating from here.

At our core, we’re a tech company. We build our own insurtech platform and rely heavily on data, automation, and AI to redesign the end-to-end insurance experience:  from underwriting to claims. Combined with a fully digital customer portal and strong UX, we’re turning insurance into something surprisingly simple, transparent, and fair.

We’re led by seasoned entrepreneurs who’ve built and scaled companies before, and we bring that same ambition, urgency, and ownership mindset to everything we do.


What you'll be doing:

Insify is looking for an entrepreneurial and analytical Product Manager to drive the growth and evolution of our Property & Casualty (P&C) portfolio. This role focuses on the essential "bread and butter" products for SMEs: including General Liability, Professional Indemnity, and Property insurance.

Unlike traditional PM roles, you won't just be managing features; you will be the "CEO" of your products. You will bridge the gap between complex insurance logic and a seamless digital user experience. You use your deep understanding of our customers and data native approach to translate technical policy wordings and insurance products into automated underwriting flows and digital-first customer journeys taking away the complexity for our customers.

This is a perfect role for someone with a background in business operations, consulting, or insurance who wants to move into a high-growth tech environment and take tangible ownership of a product's performance.


What you’ll be up to (some examples):
  • Drive Product Strategy: Manage the roadmap for your products, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant, and easy to purchase online.
  • Optimize the Funnel: Use data to identify friction points in the application process and work with Design and Tech to improve conversion rates.
  • Scale New Markets: Support the launch of our digital proposition into new European markets, adapting local requirements into our scalable core platform.
  • Stakeholder Management: Coordinate between Insurance, Tech, Marketing, and Customer Ops to ensure a unified product vision and smooth execution.
  • Monitor Performance: Track loss ratios, retention, and customer feedback to iterate on the product and pricing strategy.
    • This role is a strong fit if you are a "doer" who loves to solve puzzles. You can dive deep into the fine print of an insurance policy one hour and brainstorm a new UI flow with a developer the next.

    Specifically, you bring:
  • 2–4 years of experience in a high-growth startup or strategy consulting (Insurance, Fintech, or E-commerce preferred).
  • Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable with Excel/data tools and use metrics to back up your decisions.
  • Product Curiosity: You don't need to be a coder, but you should be excited about how APIs, automated underwriting, and LLMs can transform insurance.
  • Bias for Action: You prefer "shipping and iterating" over "analyzing and waiting."
  • Communication: Excellent English skills (Dutch, German, or French is a major plus given our European footprint).

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
jobs.description:
Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report.

Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off.

You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What impact you will have

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and decisions for our financial statements product, with clear domain ownership

  • Lead product direction in a key area with direct and clear business impact

  • Reimagine how auditors and financial professionals work, making their workflows more defensible

Why it's an exciting challenge

  • Reviewers are sceptical, and they should be. A finding they can't trace is a finding they check again by hand.

  • Statements differ by country, by standard and by firm. FSS has to be right on all of them, not just the ones in front of you this week.

  • Firms use FSS when the stakes are highest. Every change has to make their next busy season better, not riskier.

  • Everyone has a request: firms, sales, partners and engineering. You'll decide which ones the evidence supports, and say no to the rest.

What you'll own

  • The full FS experience: how a team moves through a draft, from the first finding to sign-off

  • Trust in every check: each finding shows what it compared, where the figures came from, and who reviewed it

  • Quality: what "ready to ship" means for each check, and how the team knows a change helps without breaking something else

  • Where FSS goes next: which statement types, standards and markets come first, and why

     

What you'll do

  • Set the plan and make trade-offs explicit, including new checks versus improving the ones customers already rely on

  • Spend time with auditors: watch real reviews, see where they double-check by hand, and turn that into product decisions

  • Work with engineering and audit experts on sets of real statements that every change has to pass

  • Use product data to decide: which findings reviewers accept, reject or ignore, and why

  • Build on Alwin's shared platform capabilities, and raise dependencies with other teams early

  • Help sales and customer success decide which customers and statements FSS is ready for

  • Write clearly: decisions, specs, and requirements so the team can drive forward with clarity and speed

What you'll bring

Must-have:

  • Product management experience on B2B software where getting it right matters: audit, accounting, tax, legal, compliance or financial services

  • A strong business acumen and focus on business impact

  • Experience shipping AI, machine learning or document-processing features, and making their output something people can check

  • Comfort with data: you can read an error analysis, query your own numbers and spot a sample that isn't representative

  • A record of prioritising for a large user base with demanding customers and competing stakeholders both internal and external

  • Enough technical depth to make trade-offs with engineers on accuracy, data and architecture

Strong-to-have:

  • Creative mindset thinking beyond how problems are solved today to reimagine a future approach that drive productivity

  • Experience in agentic products, workflows and systems

jobs.title: Product Manager - Storage
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible, from compute orchestration and Kubernetes to bare metal, storage, and networking.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

As a Storage Product Manager on the Cloud team, you will own the strategy and roadmap for Mistral's storage product portfolio. You have a deep understanding of the storage stack from block storage, distributed filesystems, object storage, and the evolving storage technology that accelerate AI/ML and HPC workloads. You understand what is slowing down the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud — translating those insights into products that are flexible, easy to build on, and performant at scale.

You will work closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to build new products and enhance existing offerings, ensuring alignment with technological advancements, customer expectations, and market trends. This is a highly critical role with significant influence over the future of AI compute and storage products.

What You’ll Do

  • Product strategy: Define and execute the product vision for Mistral's storage offerings — including distributed filesystem, block, and object storage to keep pace with the needs of AI training and inference at scale.

  • Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Cloud Software Engineering, and SRE to define technical specifications, execution timelines, and the performance, reliability, scalability, and cost targets the different storage products must hit.

  • Data strategy and architecture: Drive the data lifecycle, tiering, durability, and failure-domain strategy in close partnership with engineering.

  • Roadmap ownership: Own and prioritize the storage product roadmap, balancing customer requests, technical feasibility, and business impact.

  • Customer discovery: Build deep relationships with the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud, understand their storage needs and pain points, and act as their voice inside the company.

  • Market Analysis: Research trends, opportunities, and challenges in the storage domain, and use these insights to guide product development and positioning.

  • Technical translation: Distill complex technical tradeoffs into clear, compelling narratives and decision documents for company leadership.

  • Performance monitoring: Track and analyze product performance metrics and use data-driven insights to guide product enhancements and future direction.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in product management, with a strong focus on storage and cloud infrastructure, particularly in high-performance or AI-driven environments

  • Strong understanding of storage technologies, including file system, block and object storage.

  • Solid technical foundation and cloud-infrastructure knowledge. You’re comfortable reasoning about API semantics, control-plane vs data-plane behavior, system events and lifecycle, multi-tenant operational realities. You can engage with engineering teams as a peer, not as a translator. You can challenge an engineering tradeoff, not just relay one.

  • Track record of shipping technically complex platform products with measurable impact.

  • Strong analytical instincts with the ability to use data to inform and defend multi-year infrastructure decisions.

  • Ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams without direct authority, and to communicate credibly with executives, engineers, and customers.

  • Low ego, high bias for action, and comfort in ambiguity — equally at home crafting a strategy narrative and diving into metrics, a UX detail, or a customer escalation.

Bonus

  • You can reason about cloud storage economics, and how tiering across hot, warm, and cold tiers affects cost

  • You've designed, or worked closely on, backup, replication, or disaster recovery products

  • You're comfortable discussing storage performance characteristics: throughput, latency, IOPS, and how they map to real workloads

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.
 
We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to join our DataFetch Team. 

What the team does

 DataFetch owns the engine behind every view in Pigment: how users access, explore and display their data. Our mission is to give end users fast, easy access to their data in whatever way suits them, and to give modelers the tools to build views that are robust and performant.
 We take block data (metrics, lists, tables) and turn it into what a view actually shows: preparing the query (pivot, scope, filters, aggregations), applying access rights, and shaping results ready to render.

Why it matters

 Views and boards are how most people consume Pigment. Every grid opened, every export run and every drilldown goes through DataFetch, so our work shapes the daily experience of both end users and modelers. And increasingly, agents and AI features rely on us as the data-access layer to retrieve customer data.

What you'll do
 
- Pitch our product to existing and new customers and collect their feedback through workshops, design sessions, UX research and discovery, together with other PMs and Designers
- Build the product vision and roadmap in close collaboration with Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing and Sales; secure the flows of communication between those teams so that everyone has the necessary support and information for customer communication and day to day prioritization
- Proactively monitor the market and the competition offer, develop, document and share a solid understanding that fuels our product vision, strategy and choices
- You will own your product area end-to-end: from defining the vision and strategy, to leading discovery, prioritization, and delivery with your engineering and design partners.
- Participate to continuous improvements of the quality of the product and our delivery processes, help stakeholder teams grow and scale with maximum efficiency
 
Scope & Ownership 
 
- Own a product domain 
- Define and drive the product strategy for your area
- Lead product discovery and shape high-impact bets
- Be accountable for user value

- Clear product strategy defined for your domain

- Recognized as a thought leader in your squad

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Perk works best when it connects seamlessly with the tools and platforms our customers

already rely on. From ERP and accounting systems to workplace software, mobility providers,

technology platforms, and emerging AI ecosystems, these third-party relationships can directly

shape the value customers get from Perk.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partnerships to own and build those relationships.

Unlike our Growth Partnerships and Supplier Partnerships teams, this role isn’t responsible for

generating sales pipeline or supplier commission revenue. Its goal is to make Perk’s product

and customer experience stronger through the third parties we depend on and integrate with.

You’ll determine where strategic relationships can unlock the most customer value, build and

manage those partnerships, secure the access and agreements our teams need, and work

closely with Product and Engineering to turn them into successful customer-facing experiences.

This is a new role at Perk with significant opportunity to define how Product Partnerships should

work as we scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Build our product partnership strategy: Translate Perk’s product and company priorities into a clear roadmap of third-party relationships across areas such as ERP and accounting, business software, mobility, integration platforms, and AI.

  • Own strategic partner relationships: Serve as Perk’s primary relationship owner for the external platforms and technology companies that enable or enhance customer-facing product experiences.

  • Unlock Product and Engineering: Secure the developer access, API licences, programme memberships, certifications, marketplace approvals, and other partner support our teams need to build and maintain integrations.

  • Structure and negotiate partnerships: Lead commercial and strategic discussions around API access, data, licensing, marketplace participation, co-marketing, and other partnership terms, working closely with Legal, Security, Finance, Product, and Engineering.

  • Partner with Product on priorities: Bring the partner and market perspective into roadmap discussions while Product Managers own product requirements and delivery. Help determine which external relationships and integration models create the greatest customer value.

  • Own the partner lifecycle: Manage relationships from initial engagement through integration, certification, launch, ongoing roadmap alignment, escalations, programme changes, and renewals.

  • Drive adoption and customer value: Work with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support to ensure partnerships aren’t simply launched—they are discoverable, useful, reliable, and adopted by customers.

  • Build the Product Partnerships playbook: Establish how Perk evaluates, prioritises, launches, measures, and manages product partnerships as this function grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem partnerships, business development, or a product-adjacent role within SaaS, fintech, or B2B technology.

  • Experience building and managing complex relationships with technology or platform companies, ideally including developer, API, certification, or marketplace programmes.

  • Comfortable working with Product and Engineering and understanding technical concepts such as APIs, OAuth, data models, sandboxes, and integration dependencies without needing to be an engineer.

  • Ability to distinguish between an interesting partnership and one that will meaningfully improve Perk’s product or customer experience.

  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills across both external partners and senior internal stakeholders.

  • Able to move complex initiatives forward across Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Sales without relying on direct authority.

  • Comfortable defining the strategy, operating model, priorities, and processes for a new function rather than inheriting an established playbook.

  • Able to build the case for a partnership and measure its impact through adoption, customer experience, integration quality, and other relevant outcomes.

  • Based within commuting distance of our London or Barcelona hub.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP, accounting, spend management, payments, travel, or fintech ecosystems.

  • Experience managing relationships with major business software, technology, mobility, or AI platforms.

  • Familiarity with unified API or integration-platform models.

  • Experience with European ERP and accounting ecosystems across markets such as DACH, Benelux, France, the Nordics, or the UK.

  • Additional European languages.

 

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

The Process

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60 mins - IRL / Virtual

  • Values interview - 30 mins - Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.description:
Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source.

Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement.

You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work.

This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

The problems you'll own

  • A firm's procedure must become a harness an agent can follow, with the right context, tools and review points

  • Models are non-deterministic, but audit work must be defensible: traceable, attributed and reviewed

  • A firm will only rely on an agent it can test, approve and trace

  • Reviewer feedback must make agents better, with the firm's approval and without anything reaching another client

  • Methodology, models and standards all change. Agents in use must keep up without breaking work in progress

What you'll do

  • Own the Agent Builder strategy and roadmap, and make the trade-offs explicit

  • Design the harness with engineering: how context is assembled, how tools are defined and called, and where a person must review

  • Decide what builders control and what the platform sets, so agents can encode real methodology and stay consistent

  • Build the feedback loops: turn run traces and reviewer edits into eval cases, regression tests and changes the firm approves

  • Set the quality gates an agent must pass before release, and test every new model or methodology version before it reaches live work

  • Report agent quality with a stated method and sample

  • Prototype in code before you write specs. Then write short specs and decision memos that engineers can build from

  • Spend time with the firms that build and approve agents, and turn what our forward-deployed teams learn into product, not one-off fixes

What you bring

  • A technical background: software, ML or infrastructure engineering, or several years as a technical PM on developer or AI platforms

  • Hands-on experience shipping agent systems in production: context and retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, retries and fallbacks

  • Eval practice: building datasets, calibrating LLM judges against human labels, offline and online evaluation, and regression testing across model versions

  • Observability for LLM systems: traces, cost and latency, and classifying failures so you fix causes, not symptoms

  • System design skills: schemas, versioning, permissions, event logs and APIs. You can read a design doc and challenge it

  • PM experience on a product that other people build on

  • Prototyping in code with AI tools as part of your normal work

  • Clear, short writing

What sets you apart

  • Audit or accounting knowledge, from practice or from building products for auditors, finance teams or other experts in regulated fields

  • Document AI: extraction, OCR, grounding and citation

  • You've built an agent harness or framework, eval tooling, or LLM observability

  • You've built review workflows or feedback pipelines that turn user corrections into eval or training data

  • Experience with low-code tools, workflow designers, rule engines or DSLs

  • Design-partner programmes with large enterprise customers

What We Offer

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised.

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

  • A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

  • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

  • Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

 

Recruitment steps

  • Assessment interview

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Deine Mission

Produkt und Design sind bei Bling eine Rolle.Du baust bei uns eigene Features, vom User-Problem bis zum Release. Du findest das Problem, entwickelst das Konzept, gestaltest die Lösung selbst in Figma und briefst sie übergabereif für die Entwicklung. Nach dem Launch schaust du dir an, wie dein Feature genutzt wird, und entscheidest, was als Nächstes passiert.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of Product und trägst vom ersten Monat an die Verantwortung für deine Features.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst Ownership für eigene Features, von der User-Problem-Discovery über die Konzeption bis zum Launch
  • Du gestaltest die Lösungen selbst in Figma: User Flows und Screens auf Basis unseres Design Systems
  • Du übersetzt deine Konzepte und Designs in klare Tickets für unsere Entwickler und erarbeitest die technische Umsetzung gemeinsam mit ihnen
  • Du verantwortest Releases und stehst für die Qualität der gebauten Funktionen ein
  • Du erkennst Reibungspunkte in der User Journey und entwickelst Lösungen, die Conversion, Activation und Retention messbar verbessern
  • Du analysierst nach dem Launch die Nutzung, initiierst Experimente und A/B-Tests und leitest daraus die nächsten Schritte ab

Dein Profil

  • Du hast schon etwas gebaut und kannst es zeigen: ein Feature, ein Side Project, eine App. Ob aus ein bis zwei Jahren im Product Management oder Product Design oder aus starken Praktika, ist uns egal
  • Du hast Freude daran, Produkte zu skalieren, und willst sehen, dass sich deine Arbeit in den Zahlen zeigt
  • Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben. Du siehst ein Problem, machst es zu deinem und lässt es erst los, wenn es gelöst ist
  • Du fühlst dich sicher im Umgang mit Figma und hast ein gutes Gespür für UX/UI und ästhetische Interfaces
  • Du denkst in der Konzeption schon die Umsetzung mit und kannst mit Entwicklern auf Augenhöhe über Lösungen diskutieren
  • Du arbeitest aktiv mit AI und weißt, wo sie dir Arbeit abnimmt und wo du besser selbst ran musst
  • Du übernimmst Ownership, arbeitest strukturiert mit Roadmaps, Tickets und Deadlines und hältst dabei ein hohes Tempo
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und sehr gutes Englisch, lebst in Berlin und bist drei Tage pro Woche bei uns im Büro

Was dich erwartet

  • Echte Ownership: Deine Features landen bei über 150.000 Familien
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Head of Product, mit kurzen Wegen, schnellem Feedback und steiler Lernkurve
  • Ein MacBook und hochwertiges Equipment, damit du bestens ausgestattet bist, um erfolgreich zu arbeiten
  • Ein flexibles Hybrid-Arbeitsmodell, das dir ermöglicht, im Büro oder von zu Hause zu arbeiten – mit der Option, gelegentlich auch remote zu arbeiten
  • Subventionierter Urban Sports Club, ein Bling-Mobile Tarif und weitere Benefits
  • Ein modernes, lebendiges Büro im Herzen von Berlin Mitte mit einer voll ausgestatteten Küche mit kostenlosen Getränken, Frühstück, Snacks und unserer Siebträger Kaffeemaschine
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents, die unsere Unternehmenskultur stärken und jeden Erfolg noch schöner machen

Deine Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen CV und einen Link zu etwas, das du gebaut hast.

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager - Claap
jobs.description:
we're hiring our first PM at Claap. You'll own the core product across three big topics in-app agentic experience, off-app agentic experience and enterprise readiness working directly with Robin, our co-founder and CEO.

About Claap

Claap is the AI-native Revenue Intelligence platform for sales and revenue teams.

What makes us different: we were the first platform in our category designed from day one to be used by both humans AND AI agents. We were also the first in our category to release an MCP, back in May 2025, over 18 months ago. Every customer conversation we capture is structured for two consumers: the rep who needs to act on it, and the agents (yours, ours, third-party) that need to feed on it to do their work.

This matters because the biggest shift we see across our customer base, from Series B startups to enterprise customers like Infopro Digital, Didomi, Dash0, and Pelico, is the move toward collaboration between humans, agents, and software. Our customers' executives are under real pressure to deploy AI across sales, business development, and customer-facing functions. Claap is often the conversation-data backbone that makes those agentic workflows possible.

Claap is now part of lempire (lemlist), giving us the ambition to build the agentic revenue platform (from prospection to closing) of the next decade.

We're a small team. Every hire matters and we are looking for our 1st PM.

As the first Product Manager at Claap, your mission is to drive the product's future developments and roadmap, working hand in hand with Robin, our co-founder and CEO, who has led product since day one.

You will work with Robin on three big topics:

- In-app agentic experience: In the past few months, we have extended our context infra. We now need to put this context at work to truly move the needle for our sales clients and help them close faster. Think next best action for the sales rep (prep meeting, build decks, contact people, follow ups & co), assisted pipeline reviews & forecasts or sales coaching.

- Off-app agentic experience: Claap is becoming headless, consumed more and more through MCP. We now need to level up our MCP integrations to make Claap fully sticky and efficient through MCP usage in 3rd party agents. Think MCP tools, plugins, embed skills or Claude artifact app.

- Enterprise readiness: our customers are moving upmarket, and enterprise accounts need governance, admin settings, permissions and configuration capabilities to roll Claap out at scale. Think SSO/SCIM, roles and permissions, data retention policies, and admin analytics.

The lemlist integration and our end-to-end sales agent roadmap will stay with Robin, which leaves you real ownership on the core Claap product (ie closing).

Your role is to understand the market and customer needs (especially in this AI era), identify the best possible product evolutions, prioritize them, work hand-in-hand with developers and designers to build an amazing product experience, and have a strong focus on go-to-market with Sales and Marketing to make sure the impact is reached.

Your scope can change over time; we are a truly agile company: we iterate a lot, even on how we organize and work together.

The PM at Claap wears different hats

- A detective/explorer hat to find unusual insights & opportunities, read between the lines of what sales teams really need, and be visionary when needed

- A chess player hat to think strategically, create good decision constraints, double down on the right things, and always have a coup d'avance

- An investor hat to make the right bets at the right time with the right amount of resources, because you sometimes need to play fast and risky, and sometimes need to play safe

- A diplomat hat to influence your teammates on what we should spend time and effort on, win their trust, and bring visibility, focus, vision and motivation

- A builder hat to get your hands dirty with AI, prototype, test and ship, instead of only writing specs about it

What you are not

- A Project Manager who only talks about methodologies and frameworks

- A Product Owner writing super detailed 4-page tickets for devs

- A feature factory building every custom request an enterprise prospect asks for

- The "Notion docs & meetings person" with no real impact on our users and the business

- A "yes man" for every idea and suggestion people bring to you

- A people manager looking for a team to run: this role is hands-on

Key results

Within 3 months you will have

- Developed a deep understanding of Claap, the call intelligence market and our product vision

- Built relationships with Claap users, from sales reps to the admins of our largest accounts

- Mapped the enterprise requirements that slow down or block our deals, and shipped the first ones

- Identified the key closing jobs to be done and shipped first iterations with your squad

- Won the trust of your squad, Robin, and the Sales and CS teams

Within 12 months you will have

- Made Claap truly enterprise-ready: governance, settings and configuration are no longer a reason we lose a deal

- Made Claap a must-have in our users' closing workflow, with measurable adoption and retention

- Positively impacted the company's revenue through solutions you've helped launch

- Influenced the Claap product vision by suggesting transformative developments

What's in it for you?

- A founding role: you're the first PM at Claap, with real ownership on a fast-growing AI product and a direct line to the founders

- Helping thousands of sales professionals close more deals

- A chance to work with an innovative, fast-paced team with a bias for action

- Opportunity to shape our company's direction

- Potential to establish yourself as an expert in AI for sales

Preferred experience

Must have

- You have 5+ years of experience in product. Scale-up experience is highly preferred.

- You have a strong academic background (business school, engineering school or equivalent) and/or experience in top-tier companies.

- You are a hands-on PM: you are an individual contributor today, or you led product at an early-stage startup.

- You have a real taste and curiosity for AI and tech, ideally with features or agents you've launched end to end.

- You have a big bias for action: you are a "débrouillard" and understand the value of speed & execution.

- You have strong communication skills.

- You speak French and English. This is non-negotiable: most of our enterprise accounts are French-speaking.

- You have a strong pragmatism.

- You have a solid knowledge of SaaS markets & mechanisms.

- You have a strong business acumen.

Nice to have

- You have experience in enterprise or upper mid-market SaaS (permissions, admin, SSO, security reviews).

- You have worked on sales tech, revenue intelligence or tools used by sales teams.

- You have Growth, Revenue Operations or Sales experience.

- You know how to wireframe designs.

- You are humble and look for clues that you are wrong.

- You are curious, always asking questions and learning new stuff.

Additional Information

- Competitive salary + profit sharing

- Where you live and work is totally up to you: we do have an office in Paris if you enjoy life at the office 🇫🇷

- Profit sharing: when lempire wins, all team members share the profits

- Alan Blue: comprehensive 100% premium medical coverage for you and your family

- Swile Meal Tickets: daily meal tickets to fuel productivity

- Navigo Card: 100% covered Navigo card

- Full-remote work setup: a well-funded home office budget

- Gear: a laptop + the tools and equipment you need for your job

- Team building: we all meet once a year at really cool places around the world

Recruitment process

- Interview with Victoire, our Talent Acquisition Manager

- Interview with Robin, Claap co-founder and CEO

- Business Case (async.) + Live Q&A with Robin and Pierre

- Team fit

- Interview with Charles, our CEO

- Reference Check

- Offer

How to apply

Include a short note (200 words max) on an AI feature or agent you shipped end to end. It's the hardest thing to read on a CV, so we screen for it from day one.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using.

Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 18-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Team Lead to take ownership of our Reporting platform and lead the team responsible for its evolution. This is a player-coach role for a staff-level data engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong engineering leadership and people management skills.

You will help design, deploy, and evolve the data infrastructure that powers Adikteev’s reporting and analytics systems. You will be both the technical architect of the platform and the manager of the team that enables reliable, scalable, and high-value reporting for our internal and external users.

As the team lead, you won't just "execute" tasks. You will shape our technical DNA and support the growth of the team.

Engineering:

  • Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for our Reporting platform and data infrastructure.

  • Architect, scale, and maintain our data infrastructure, ensuring it meets the rigorous demands of reporting, analytics, and business intelligence workflows.

  • Make sure data is always available and reliable: oversee processing, storage, aggregation, transformation, and API development.

  • Streamline our data processes by integrating efficient testing, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and error recovery.

  • Design and implement robust data models and transformation pipelines that make reporting data easy to discover, understand, and use.

  • Build and optimize highly scalable pipelines using Apache Airflow and Apache Spark, focusing on high reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

  • Establish best practices for data quality, CI/CD for data, observability, technical documentation, and operational excellence.

  • Contribute to innovation efforts by exploring promising ideas from recent academic and industry work and turning them into production-grade solutions.

  • Leverage AI coding tools such as Copilot and Claude to accelerate development cycles and stay at the forefront of engineering productivity.

  • Remain hands-on where it creates the most leverage, contributing to system design, code reviews, critical implementation work, and incident resolution.

Management:

  • Lead, support, and develop the Reporting engineering team, creating the conditions for engineers to do their best work.

  • Set clear objectives, priorities, and expectations for the team, aligned with company and product goals.

  • Manage the team’s roadmap and delivery, balancing business priorities, platform reliability, technical debt, and long-term investments.

  • Provide regular feedback, coaching, and career development support to team members.

  • Mentor Data and Backend Engineers and help them grow their technical scope, ownership, and leadership skills.

  • Participate in recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, and team planning.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high engineering standards.

  • Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and technical risks before they impact the business, and communicate architectural decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WHO YOU ARE

You might be a great fit for our Reporting team if you have experience in several of the following areas:

  • Experience: Proven track record as a Staff Data Engineer, Lead Data Engineer, Principal Data Engineer, or Engineering Manager with a strong data engineering background. You have worked on production systems where latency, throughput, availability, reliability, and infrastructure cost matter.

  • Data Volume: Experience working with very large-scale data systems. At Adikteev, our platforms process more than 5 billion events per day and reach over 5 million QPS on some services. You are comfortable designing systems that can handle high data volumes, demanding throughput, and strict reliability requirements.

  • Technical Stack: Hands-on expertise with Apache Spark, including tuning and scaling, as well as Apache Airflow and complex DAG orchestration. Kafka streaming, Kubernetes, and AWS are a plus.

  • Coding Skills: You are an "AI-native" developer who embraces AI tools to write better and faster code. Hands-on experience with Scala. Python and Java are a plus.

  • Data Modeling: Strong experience designing data models for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases. Experience with dimensional modeling, data warehouses, or data lakes is a plus.

  • Data Transformation: Solid understanding of how to transform raw data into accurate, consistent, and easy-to-use reporting datasets. Experience building or maintaining reporting or analytics platforms is a strong plus.

  • Engineering Leadership: Experience defining technical direction, setting engineering standards, driving execution across teams, and making architectural decisions at staff level.

  • People Management: Experience managing, mentoring, and developing engineers, providing regular feedback, supporting career growth, and building a high-performing team.

  • Communication: Fluent in English and able to articulate complex architectural choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable creating alignment across teams and communicating clearly at every level.

Please note that, to comply with employment regulations, applicants are required to maintain residency and be legally authorized to work in the European Union in order to be considered for this position.

COMPENSATION

  • Competitive Salary between 100,000 and 120,000€ OTE

We are committed to transparent compensation practices. The salary range shown reflects total On-Target Earnings (OTE), including base salary and a performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs. Final compensation will be tailored to each candidate’s background, experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Longevity bonus every 2 years;

  • Profit-sharing scheme

  • Healthcare plan with excellent coverage;

  • Lunch Vouchers;

  • Mental Health support;

  • Flexible remote working policy;

  • Inclusive parental leave Policy.

*Most benefits are available to all employees. For remote team members based outside of France, benefits will be aligned with local laws and practices in your country of residence, ensuring support that’s both relevant and compliant wherever you are. 

OUR PROCESS
