  • HR call with Maxime, Team Lead - Talent Acquisition,

  • Technical interview with Youcef, Senior Engineering Team Lead, & Adrian, Senior Data Engineer

  • Team fit interview with Aldenis, VP Engineering, 

  • A final interview with Cédric, Chief Technology Officer and Loïc, Chief Product Officer. 

If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team.

OUR COMMITMENT

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About The Role

As a Technical Program Manager for GPU and Data Center Deployments, you will own end-to-end program delivery for bringing data center infrastructure and AI clusters online. You will operate in a highly ambiguous environment, coordinating across construction, infrastructure, networking, systems engineering, procurement, and operations — driving execution from planning through operational handoff.

 

This is an ownership role. You will be expected to move programs forward with incomplete information, surface and resolve gaps before they become blockers, and hold multiple workstreams accountable across time zones and organizational boundaries. The best candidates bring deep experience at the intersection of data center construction handover and AI/GPU hardware deployment. You know how construction sequences impact infrastructure readiness, how ICT and CDU work intersect, and how to drive multi-threaded bring-up programs spanning hardware, networking, power, and cooling.

 

What You'll Do

Program Delivery & Execution

  • Own end-to-end delivery of GPU cluster activations and data center infrastructure programs, from initial strategic planning through operational handoff.

  • Drive multi-threaded bring-up programs spanning hardware, networking, power, and cooling — owning plans, dependencies, and critical paths.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams responsible for construction, infrastructure, network, hardware, ICT, commissioning, and operations, including vendor and contractor partners.

  • Anticipate downstream impacts of technical sequencing decisions on capacity, schedule, and cluster performance; identify and resolve blockers before they surface.

  • Manage and hold accountable vendors, integration contractors, and third-party service providers across the full deployment lifecycle.

  • Partner with engineering to improve cluster turn-up reliability, repeatability, and automation — reducing time-to-serve for new capacity.

  • Support network operations and end-to-end physical and logical bring-up, including on-site deployment, rack cabling, and coordination with engineering teams.

  • Maintain momentum through changing requirements, tight timelines, and cross-time-zone execution.

Stakeholder & Executive Communication

  • Influence senior executive and c-suite strategic approaches.

  • Deliver crisp executive-level program status briefings covering schedule health, risks, key decisions, and escalation paths across a broad portfolio of concurrent programs.

  • Translate complex technical requirements — from highly detailed customer RFPs, integration specs, and architecture documents — into actionable plans for engineering, finance, and marketing stakeholders.

  • Serve as the primary cross-functional point of contact between engineering, operations, customers, and leadership; code-switch fluently between deeply technical and business-facing audiences.

  • Interface with chip and hardware providers to derisk onboarding to new platforms across compute, networking, and cooling stacks.

  • Facilitate alignment across stakeholders at all levels — from network engineers to C-suite — with confidence, clarity, and no ego.

Program Infrastructure & Process

  • Build and operationalize program mechanisms — roadmaps, milestones, risk registers, RACI matrices, decision logs, and deployment runbooks — that make delivery predictable at scale.

  • Establish and maintain a single source of truth for all active programs using tools such as Smartsheet, Confluence, Jira, and Notion.

  • Identify bottlenecks and systemic gaps, then drive durable fixes across tooling, process, and partner interfaces.

  • Develop scalable playbooks and governance frameworks that create accountability without creating overhead as Volta's deployment footprint grows rapidly.

  • Champion automation and digital workflows to eliminate manual effort across the program lifecycle.

 

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex data center physical infrastructure programs or large-scale GPU/AI cluster deployments in fast-moving environments.

  • Demonstrated experience bridging construction handover and cluster deployment — candidates who are network-only or construction-only will not be a fit.

  • Hands-on GPU deployment experience, including:

  • GPU cluster deployment and activation (NVIDIA infrastructure preferred)

Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

 

Role Overview

We're hiring a hands-on engineering manager for Harvey's Revenue Technology team. You'll bring software-engineering discipline to the systems our go-to-market organisation runs on, with Salesforce at the core and the CPQ, contracting, billing, marketing automation, revenue intelligence and post-sale platforms around it, and you'll put AI to work across that stack. You'll start as a player-coach: shipping yourself, setting the architecture and release practices for the system administrators and product owners already on the team, and hiring the engineers who come next. You'll be based in Dublin or London, with enough overlap with US stakeholders to stay tightly coupled to the wider team.

Harvey's go-to-market organisation is growing quickly, and this role owns the engineering practice behind its systems: how we design, build, test, release and monitor on Salesforce and the platforms around it, and the engineering standards across custom development, integrations and agents. The ideal candidate is a working manager: someone with hands-on Salesforce engineering and DevOps experience, who has led an engineering team and shipped AI agents that sellers actually use. Harvey builds AI for legal professionals; the internal bar has to match the external one.

At Harvey, we value Decisiveness, Simplicity, and the mindset that Job's Not Finished. We move fast, prioritize clarity, and are always striving for excellence. If this resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

 

What You'll Do

  • Stay hands-on. Spend a meaningful share of your time in the work - designing systems, reviewing code, writing integrations, unblocking your engineers on production issues. You set the technical bar by demonstrating it.

  • Own the architecture of the GTM platform. Take responsibility for how Salesforce and the surrounding GTM systems fit together across lead-to-cash and the post-sale lifecycle, including reliability, data integrity, security posture, and lifecycle. Decide where customisation belongs and where it doesn't.

  • Drive AI enablement into the business. Apply AI and automation to how our go-to-market teams work, with the evaluation and guardrail practices that make it safe, and drive adoption with the teams that use it.

  • Build and lead the team. Hire, onboard, and develop the software engineers who join Revenue Technology, and set the architectural direction for the system administrators and product owners you work alongside. Own the interview loop, ramp plans, and performance for the engineering discipline.

  • Partner with business and systems owners. Work directly with Sales, Marketing Operations, Customer Success and Support, Deal Desk, Finance Systems and Enterprise Integrations to turn ambiguous business problems into scoped, sequenced engineering work, and to say no clearly when something shouldn't be built.

  • Establish engineering standards. Define how this team writes, tests, deploys, documents, and monitors what it builds. Introduce the practices that scale a growing team without adding process for its own sake.

  • Anchor Revenue Technology in EMEA. Provide senior technical presence in Dublin or London for a growing international sales organisation, and hold enough overlap with US stakeholders to stay tightly coupled to the wider org.

  • Make build-vs-buy calls. Assess when a business need is better solved by configuration, a vendor, an integration, custom code or an agent we build, and make that call with cost, security, and long-term maintenance in view.

 

What You Have

  • 7+ years of hands-on engineering on Salesforce-centred business systems, and experience leading engineers as a manager, tech lead or architect.

  • Salesforce engineering experience (Apex, LWC, Flows, integrations) and hands-on experience setting up Salesforce DevOps: source control, CI/CD, sandbox strategy and release management.

  • Hands-on engineering depth in a modern language (Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar) and real experience designing and operating API-based integrations between business systems.

  • Working knowledge of the GTM stack beyond the CRM (CPQ, marketing automation, revenue intelligence, support and customer-success platforms, contract and billing systems) and how lead-to-cash and the post-sale lifecycle actually flow across them.

  • Demonstrated experience building and shipping LLM-based agents or automations into production, outside a vendor's packaged agent product, with a clear point of view on evaluation, guardrails, and where the technology does and doesn't hold up.

  • Track record of hiring and developing engineers, and of raising the technical bar on a team you inherited or built.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, especially with non-technical teams.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and global environment.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience standing up an engineering practice inside a team that was previously admin- and configuration-led, or in a new office or region.

  • Background at a high-growth B2B SaaS company scaling through 2,000+ employees.

  • Hands-on work with MCP, agent orchestration frameworks, or LLM gateway and evaluation tooling.

  • Fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as a daily working practice.

  • Experience with enterprise iPaaS platforms (e.g., Workato) and event-driven integration patterns.

  • Exposure to legal, professional services, or another regulated industry.

This is account-led selling rather than opportunity-led. You run each account like a business, over years rather than quarters.

  • Raise the bar for the AEs around you while staying closest to the customer.

Must-haves

Nice-to-haves

  • 🚀 Open source or PLG exposure: You understand how community adoption turns into enterprise revenue.

  • 🏦 Existing network: You already know senior buyers at large organisations in your territory.

Why join us?

You will take the world's largest organisations from a first n8n deployment to multi-year partnerships, with a product that technical teams already love. You will work closely with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Partnerships and Product, and with n8n leadership at the moments that matter, so your voice shapes how we sell at the top of the enterprise. n8n is growing at an exceptional pace, backed by a vibrant community and a remote-first culture built on autonomy, experimentation and high talent density. Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

  • 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto

Our mission at Tacto

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You open Italy for Tacto and win the first customers that everything else builds on.

Why this role exists

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit and a proven playbook, and now we are taking it into the rest of Europe. Italy is one of our expansion markets. It has a broad industrial base, from automotive suppliers to machinery and food production, and the category is still wide open there. That’s where you come in: you take the market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates and win the first customers and reference logos. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows in Italy from there.

Why your role matters

  • A real greenfield. You have the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market, from the ICP to the first reference logos.

  • You’re not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation.

  • You write the blueprint. What works in your first deals becomes the playbook for everyone who follows you in Italy.

  • You shape how Tacto goes international. Your insights go straight to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

What this role is and isn’t

  • Hands on: You send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won.

  • Not a managed territory: There is no machine behind you yet. You drive your own pipeline and build the motion as you go.

  • Not a remote role: You build Italy from our Munich office and travel into the market.

Your tasks

  • Open up Italy end to end: You sharpen the ICP for Spanish manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the market’s growth.

jobs.title: Solution Architect - Power & Utilities
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

As our Solutions Architect, you will act as the senior industry expert bridging the gap between our autonomous robotic technology and the Power & Utilities sector, and more broadly the maintenance, reliability and asset performance communities of asset-intensive industries. This is a highly visible, strategic role designed for a visionary who thrives on customer engagement, executive networking, and shaping product roadmaps – offering the thrill of a sales-focused environment without the pressure of a quota.

You are the counterpart, in the Product Management organization, to our Key Account Managers. While the Account Manager develops and maintains a high-touch relationship with the customer, identifies key decision-makers and devises the account penetration strategy, you deliver the solution required to fulfil the customer engagement: you aggregate and synthesize the current and future ANYbotics product stack (robot platform, operational design domain, inspection payloads, data insights, data lake integration, APM/CMMS systems integration) into cohesive technical solutions, complete with the business models and contractual frameworks tailored to our top-priority accounts. This role is central to our Go-To-Market strategy, centered on project sales and deeper, more focused engagements with key accounts.

You will define high-impact use cases, orchestrate business value engineering, and mentor our internal teams. If you are passionate about driving product vision and enjoy travelling to connect directly with industry leaders, this role offers unparalleled impact.


The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics is a tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics through Embodied AI across multiple industries. Our autonomous quadruped robots, like ANYmal, are redefining safety and productivity in the world’s most demanding environments – from offshore oil rigs to chemical plants, power plants, substations, utilities and other complex industrial sectors. We provide an end-to-end solution that combines cutting-edge autonomy, high-value data analytics and mechanical engineering excellence, enabling the autonomous inspection and monitoring of large-scale facilities, increasing safety while maximizing uptime for the world’s most critical infrastructure.

This creates an interesting commercial environment. Our deals do not stop when a contract is signed: orders have downstream implications across Finance and Operations and ultimately lead to the delivery and deployment of physical technology, integrated with customer systems, at customer sites.


About Us

ANYbotics is a leading robotics company developing autonomous mobile robots for industrial inspection. Headquartered in Zurich and with a growing international presence, our team brings together expertise across robotics, software, hardware, product, operations and commercial functions. As our customer base and commercial organization scale, we are investing in the processes and capabilities needed to support that growth – this role is one of them.


Your Contributions
  • Architect vertical solutions. Design tailored solutions and define compelling use cases for the Power & Utilities industry, synthesising robotics, inspection payloads and data insights into solutions that integrate seamlessly into customer workflows and systems (APM, CMMS/EAM, historians, DCS/SCADA). Build the supporting business models and contractual frameworks needed to deliver turnkey value.
  • Quantify customer outcomes. Lead business value engineering: build robust business cases with quantitative ROI (avoided downtime, exposure hours, inspection cost, integrity risk) and qualitative benefits, and articulate clearly the tangible business benefits of our autonomous inspection solutions.
  • Partner with executives and the Commercial team. Work closely with prospect and customer executives to drive strategic alignment, lead customer discovery and value engineering workshops, and act as the consultative product partner to Key Account Managers on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Enable Go-to-Market excellence. Develop and deliver sales enablement toolkits – vertical positioning, use-case catalogues, competitive intelligence, reference architectures and training – so the Commercial team can articulate our value and win in your vertical.
  • Evangelize our technology. Represent ANYbotics within the partner ecosystem (APM/EAM software vendors, engineering and service partners), lead professional sessions at industry events, and engage with independent analysts (e.g. Gartner).
  • Shape the roadmap. Bring deep industry insights to product marketing and product management; identify emerging value drivers and work directly with Product Managers and R&D to embed your market vision in the technical roadmap.
  • Mentor. Share critical industry knowledge with the business value consulting team and coach younger engineers and account teams.

    • Your Profile
  • Experience:  At least 15 years of hands-on industry experience in Maintenance or Reliability Engineering, with a strong Asset Performance Management (APM) background, gained within Power & Utilities and/or other asset-heavy industries (Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Metals, high-volume Manufacturing). You have lived the reality of maintenance strategies, integrity programmes and reliability improvement inside operating plants.
  • Interdisciplinary Background:  A well-balanced background bridging software, APM and maintenance; this is not a pure hardware or automation engineering role. A strong understanding of how automated inspection, control and maintenance systems (mobile robotics, IoT, DCS/SCADA, CMMS, APM) fit into complex industrial workflows.
  • Customer and deal leadership:  Proven ability to lead complex customer discovery, navigate executive-level conversations and contribute heavily to major deals; a sharp observer of customer personas and pain points.
  • Financial and contractual fluency:  Comfortable building business cases, navigating pricing models and handling the business and contractual nuances of technical partnerships and strategic agreements.
  • Executive communication and influence:  Excellent written and oral communication skills; able to translate complex technical concepts into high-value narratives for audiences ranging from R&D engineers to C-suite executives, and to motivate internal stakeholders without formal authority.
  • Cross-functional collaboration:  Strong collaboration skills, particularly in partnering with product managers, product marketing and the Commercial organization.
  • Education:  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or related).
  • Grit and mobility:  A self-starter who thrives in the fast-paced environment of a scaling deep-tech company, with high enthusiasm for significant travel (30–40%+) to engage directly with customers, prospects and industry networks.

    • Bonus Points
  • Previous experience as a Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales Engineer, Product Manager, Business Value Consultant or Reliability Engineer.
  • Hands-on experience with leading APM/EAM platforms (e.g. GE Vernova APM, AVEVA, Bentley, IBM Maximo, SAP PM/IAM, Hexagon) and their integration patterns.
  • Certifications such as CMRP, CRE, API 510/570/580, or equivalent reliability and integrity credentials.
  • Experience deploying automated or robotic inspection programmes in industrial environments.
    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.
     
     
    Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN.

Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs produits digitaux et de leurs organisations. Ton rôle est d'allier vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour délivrer de la valeur tangible dans des environnements complexes.

Ce que tu fais concrètement :

  • Tu prends la main sur un périmètre produit à fort enjeu business. Tu analyses les processus en place, tu identifies les leviers d'amélioration réels et tu formalises une vision produit et une feuille de route alignées sur les priorités métier.

  • Tu décides avec la donnée. Tu mesures l'effet de tes arbitrages sur l'usage et la performance commerciale, tu construis les indicateurs qui manquent, et tu transformes une analyse en recommandation argumentée. Pas en tableau de bord de plus.

  • Tu traduis le besoin métier en produit. Exigences fonctionnelles, user stories, critères d'acceptation, priorisation que tu assumes et que tu sais défendre.

  • Tu interviens sur le socle SI. Tu contribues au cadrage et à l'évolution des briques applicatives concernées, en gardant la main sur le pourquoi quand tout le monde discute du comment.

  • Tu alignes un écosystème dense. Métiers, produit, data, IT : tu fais converger des parties prenantes multiples vers des décisions cohérentes, et tu accompagnes l'adoption des solutions auprès des équipes.

  • Tu documentes ce qui compte. Processus, décisions, dépendances, évolutions fonctionnelles : ce que tu laisses derrière toi tient sans toi.

  • Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

  • Tu as travaillé sur des briques IA (recommandation, agents, GenAI) ou tu as une appétence réelle pour intégrer l'IA au cycle produit. On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l'IA partout.

👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien.

  • Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

  • Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)

  • Des valeurs fortes : depuis 10 ans, Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l'ambition, l'expertise et l'apprentissage.

Le package : 44.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.


Pré-requis du poste

👉 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Manager ou Product Owner sur des produits digitaux, dont une expérience significative en écosystème complexe : plusieurs métiers, plusieurs systèmes, des décisions qui ne se prennent jamais seul.

  • Tu sais mener un sujet produit de la discovery aux critères d'acceptation, et tu as déjà porté une vision et une feuille de route face à des parties prenantes exigeantes.

  • Ta maturité data est réelle : tu interprètes toi-même les chiffres, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider.

  • Tu es à l'aise pour contribuer au cadrage fonctionnel de briques applicatives structurantes, sans y perdre ta hauteur de vue produit.

  • Un passage par le commerce, le e-commerce ou la supply chain, en particulier sur les sujets d'offre et de référencement, est un vrai plus. Une familiarité avec un progiciel de gestion de type SAP également.

  • Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une posture conseil assumée, une excellente communication client et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve. Anglais professionnel.

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ?

  • Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l'adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle

  • Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager

  • Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP

  • Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d'embauche

Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !

Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog.

jobs.title: Senior AI Solution Specialist
jobs.description:
Do you want to help an entire organisation turn AI opportunities into solutions that deliver real business value, while still being the person who gets hands-on and builds those solutions?

As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while actively building, configuring and testing those solutions yourself.

You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security.

This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so. You’ll design, prototype, configure, integrate and build, while also providing technical direction when needed.

Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office)
Start Date: January/February 2027

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead complex AI discovery
    Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype.

  • Build AI solutions yourself
    Design, develop, configure and test agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. You won’t only define what should be built or hand it over to others. You’ll be actively involved in building it.

  • Shape enterprise AI initiatives
    Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful.

  • Design for production
    Define solution architecture, integrations and non-functional requirements, while considering scalability, security, supportability, cost and business value.

  • Create reusable AI patterns
    Develop approaches for grounding, identity, integration, monitoring and evaluation that can be reused across teams, and identify opportunities for shared AI capabilities.

  • Coach and challenge others
    Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. You’ll work closely with our AI Solution Specialist and help raise the quality of AI solutions across Sunweb Group, while remaining an active builder yourself.

  • Strengthen responsible AI
    Contribute to our AI framework and guardrails, promote responsible use of AI and help create visibility around our AI initiatives.

Who you are

You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You know the difference between an impressive AI demo and a solution that creates measurable business value. You enjoy working independently, bringing different perspectives together and sharing what you learn along the way.

Most importantly, you’re a builder. You enjoy getting hands-on with technology, experimenting, developing prototypes and turning ideas into working solutions. You may have led technical initiatives, defined architecture or coached others, but you haven’t moved away from building things yourself, and you don’t want to.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • A proven track record of delivering complex AI, automation, integration, data or cloud solutions

  • Strong solution design skills across applications, APIs, identity, data, integrations and cloud services

  • Experience taking ambiguous business problems from discovery through prototyping, testing and solution design

  • Experience defining architecture options, non-functional requirements and production readiness

  • The ability to translate between business needs and technical possibilities

  • Confidence working with business leaders, architects, product owners and engineers

  • Strong technical leadership skills, with the ability to review, challenge and coach others without stepping away from hands-on delivery

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search and enterprise knowledge solutions

  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, connectors and/or MCP

  • Development or scripting experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# or PowerShell

  • Experience working with AI agents, assistants or orchestration workflows

  • Experience in the travel or tourism industry

Our technology

Our AI and technology landscape includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Teams, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI services, Microsoft Foundry, ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, MCP, Entra ID and Git.

Let us introduce Sunweb Group  

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.   

Why join our journey?

  • Monthly gross salary between €6500,- and €8000,- plus 6 ATV days (based on full-time employment, excluding 8% holiday allowance). Please note: ATV days do not apply to part-time contracts.

  • Enjoy up to 20% off when booking with our brands for you, your family, and your friends.  

  • As an international company we support a hybrid way of working. We provide you with office furniture and IT equipment. 

  • We enjoy the journey so enjoy 25 holidays based on fulltime employment. 

  • Access to LinkedIn Learning and a personalized Reflect & Develop Plan to support your career growth.  

  • Benefit from coaching sessions designed to support your well-being.  

  • Receive work-from-home and travel allowances to ease your daily routine.  

Ready for departure? 

Do you want to become part of our team as Senior AI Solution Specialist? Click on “Apply”. Do you have any questions? Please feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team via . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Closing date for applications: 5 December

Sunweb Group is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate in any way. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees.  

As part of our recruitment process, we use AI-supported tools to assist recruiters in matching candidates to job requirements. Final hiring decisions are always made by human recruiters.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Infra Platform Group
jobs.description:
At Channable, we're building the future of eCommerce automation - and at the core of that vision is a world-class engineering organization. We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join our Infra Platform Group, where you'll play a key role in scaling core infrastructure, empowering product engineering teams, and driving technical strategy.

🚀 About the role:

As a Senior Engineering Manager of the Infra Platform Group, you will manage two Haskell/Rust teams (Infra Blue and Infra Red) and one Python team (Python Infrastructure and Performance - PIP). The group consists of three team leads (your direct reports) who manage ~12 individual contributors in total.

These teams work on Channable’s core infrastructure, including services such as a data processing engine and a job scheduler. While scaling our applications to handle another order of magnitude increase in throughput with high speed and responsiveness is key, the work goes far beyond performance. You will focus on building new capabilities for product engineering teams, making their lives easier by delivering unified technical solutions across product groups, foreseeing infrastructure challenges, and collaborating directly with product engineering teams and the CTO to align initiatives with company strategy.

🛠 What you’ll do:

  • Drive the technical roadmap by balancing the work on scaling and performance with feature requests from the product teams

  • Quantify success by defining and measuring success metrics for the domain as well as team performance

  • Mentor and coach team leads to let them grow and excel at their jobs

  • Drive for high engineering standards by implementing good software development practices and challenging the team to come up with good designs

  • Maintain a high-performance culture through fostering accountability, being on top of performance management and focusing on employee engagement

  • Oversee and improve the hiring process for platform engineers

  • You work based on data when you can, and you ensure future decisions take data into account

💡 What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience as an Engineering Manager leading team leads (preferred) or senior engineers

  • Ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team while managing performance and professional development

  • You have a history of being a software engineer and know how to build high-quality software and the trade-offs that are to be made

  • You are experienced with functional programming concepts, and are comfortable working with either Haskell, Scala, or Rust. Experience with Python is a plus.

  • Outstanding communication skills - you're just as comfortable talking to engineers as you are with stakeholders

  • You are collaborative, empowering, and adaptable - ready to take on challenges and contribute to strategic decision-making

  • A mindset focused on pragmatism and growth - you care about setting a high standard for yourself and your team and you continue to reflect to become more productive with minimal technical debt

Some practical things we expect from you:

  • You’re available for at least 32 hours per week

  • You're willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week

  • You have a valid work permit, and you're located in the Netherlands

Our Stack includes: Haskell, Python, Rust, PostgreSQL, Redis, Ansible, Terraform, React, Prometheus. And we run all of our infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.


Important note: We understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.

Note: The official job title for this role within Channable is Engineering Manager.

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, and more than +40 nationalities.
Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, helping, taking ownership, and creating an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

🌟 Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.


What do we offer?

  • Gross annual salary ranging from € 100k-120k, including the 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. 

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: You can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. 

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 


How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Important note: In the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. While we value your ambition, please do not use AI assistance during the screening process, so we can get to know the real person behind the resume.

Note: Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration, and we believe in a diverse and inclusive team

Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

Working closely with Data Scientists, Analysts, Product Managers, and Domain Experts, you will build resilient pipelines and high-performing APIs that power real-time availability computations and market forecasts from intraday to long-term horizons. jobs.title: Product Feature Owner ADAS
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Feature Owner Team

Wayve’s Product & Delivery team turns our AI Driver technology into valuable, scalable vehicle capabilities for global OEM partners. We work at the intersection of customer needs, product strategy and engineering delivery—defining what great looks like, aligning teams around a clear outcome and ensuring that Wayve’s technology can be brought to market safely and effectively.

As part of this team, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of specific Collision Avoidance and Lane Keeping ADAS functionalities. You’ll work closely with OEM customers, product and engineering teams to define feature scope, set performance targets and guide delivery from concept through to production. Your work will directly shape how Wayve’s technology performs for customers and drivers as we progress towards higher levels of autonomy.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Act as the accountable product owner for specific ADAS features, ensuring they are delivered on time, to the agreed specification and in line with customer and business needs.

  • Partner closely with OEM customers to understand their requirements, represent their needs internally and align expectations without compromising Wayve’s product strategy.

  • Work with feature group owners and engineering teams to define feature scope, specifications, performance targets and delivery plans.

  • Engage throughout feature development, providing early feedback, participating in testing and supporting evaluation and validation activities.

  • Serve as the central point of coordination between OEMs, product and engineering teams, creating clarity, resolving ambiguity and reducing misunderstandings.

  • Identify risks early, manage trade-offs and keep teams aligned as feature requirements, customer priorities and the technology evolve.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of ADAS features across Collision Avoidance and Lane Keeping, including Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB), Lane Keeping Assist (LKA), Evasive Steering Assist (ESA), Automatic Emergency Steering (AES) and Blind Spot Monitoring (BSM).

  • Defining and evolving feature specifications in partnership with OEMs, engineering and product teams.

  • Harmonising customer requirements across OEM partners to maximise reusable assets, scalability and efficient feature delivery.

  • Setting clear performance targets and ensuring features meet customer requirements, internal capabilities and agreed delivery specifications.

  • Supporting testing, evaluation and validation to ensure feature quality and readiness for production.

  • Maintaining and evolving the strategic feature roadmap as Wayve’s technology advances towards higher levels of autonomy.

  • Participating in agile planning and delivery rituals, helping teams manage dependencies, risks and priorities effectively.

  • Ensuring feature delivery aligns with relevant automotive quality, safety and compliance expectations.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have strong experience specifying and delivering ADAS features from concept through to production, particularly across Collision Avoidance or Lane Keeping functions such as AEB, LKA, ESA, AES or BSM.

  • You understand automotive development processes, including requirements management, the V-model, ASPICE, quality and validation.

  • You are confident working directly with OEM customers: understanding their needs, negotiating requirements and representing their perspective internally while maintaining a clear view of Wayve’s product strategy.

  • You have sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with engineering teams on feature trade-offs, feasibility, testing, evaluation and validation.

  • You are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can bridge technical and commercial perspectives, creating alignment across customers, product and engineering teams.

  • You proactively identify risks and issues before they escalate, balancing immediate delivery needs with the longer-term product roadmap.

  • You are comfortable in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and can bring structure and clarity without adding unnecessary process.

  • Experience shipping complete ADAS features into large-scale automotive production programmes would be valuable.

  • Knowledge of automotive quality, safety and compliance standards—including ASPICE, SOTIF, functional safety, GSR-II and DCAS—would be valuable.

  • Experience with machine learning, LLMs or recent generative-AI methods and architectures would be beneficial.

  • You bring curiosity and a forward-looking approach to developing new ADAS capabilities and advancing the customer experience.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our Leonberg office. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces and workshops with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

  • Competency interviews (HM Interview) 45 Minutes

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (ADAS domain knowledge, Technical Depth and Presentation)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment.

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

Your work will directly shape how Wayve’s technology performs for customers and drivers as we progress towards higher levels of autonomy.

  • Act as the accountable product owner for specific Parking features, ensuring they are delivered on time, to the agreed specification and in line with customer and business needs.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Supporting testing, evaluation and validation to ensure feature quality and readiness for production.

  • Participating in agile planning and delivery rituals, helping teams manage dependencies, risks and priorities effectively.

  • Ensuring feature delivery aligns with relevant automotive quality, safety and compliance expectations.

  • You have sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with engineering teams on Parking feature trade-offs, feasibility, testing, evaluation and validation.

  • You have experience defining and integrating automotive Parking sensor systems, including USS and SVCs, with practical knowledge of interfaces, calibration, diagnostics, supplier management and sensor-specific integration and performance issues.

  • You have delivered ADAS or Parking features on resource-constrained automotive SoCs, with a practical understanding of how compute, memory, bandwidth, latency and thermal budgets shape system architecture, feature behaviour, performance and customer experience.

  • You are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can bridge technical and commercial perspectives, creating alignment across customers, product, systems, hardware, perception, platform, safety and engineering teams.

  • You proactively identify risks and issues before they escalate, balancing immediate delivery needs with the longer-term product roadmap.

  • Experience shipping complete Parking features into large-scale automotive production programmes would be valuable.

  • Knowledge of automotive quality, safety and compliance standards—including ASPICE, SOTIF, functional safety, NCAP, UNECE, GSR-II and DCAS—would be valuable.

  • Experience with AI/ML, LLMs or recent generative-AI methods and architectures would be beneficial.

  • You bring curiosity and a forward-looking approach to developing new Parking capabilities and advancing the customer experience.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our Germany office. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces and workshops with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

About the Role

Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies.

Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth.

Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

Program Planning & Execution

  • Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.
  • Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs.
  • Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early.
  • Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution.

PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes

  • Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use.
  • Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery.
  • Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow.
  • Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity.

Risk, Issue & Performance Management

  • Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges.
  • Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time.
  • Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.
  • Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention.

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking.
  • Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate.
  • Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.

Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration

  • Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
  • Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
  • Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

  • Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management.

  • A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace.

  • Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment.

  • Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken.

  • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations.

  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations.

Strong Plus

  • Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies.

  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes.

  • Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management.

Nice to Have

  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe.

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries.

  • Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations.

Who You Are

  • You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results.

  • You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle.

  • You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture.

  • You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans.

  • You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations.

Jons, as Chief of Staff, creates the traction: the operating model, the portfolio, the prioritisation, and the decisions that turn direction into shipped product. Around them sit product managers, product marketing, growth, brand, content and design, and three product pods that do the building.

What holds those two ends together is the work itself: every initiative visible, owned and moving, and every decision captured before it evaporates. That is this job. As Program Manager you run Nalden_OS — the operating loop of the CPO portfolio — day to day. You do not own the initiatives; you make sure each one has someone who does.

You join while that loop is being built rather than maintained, so you shape it: what gets tracked, how reviews run, what a decision record looks like, and which reporting we stop doing because nobody reads it.

In this role you will

  • Keep the whole portfolio visible, with an explicit owner on every line of work in flight across the CPO office and the product pods.

  • Prepare the decisions: shape ambiguous work until it is ready to be decided on, and prepare the prioritisation calls and operating reviews for the CPO and the Chief of Staff.

  • Make it move: track progress and dependencies across teams, surface blockers early, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a status update.

  • Make it stick: capture decisions and the reasoning behind them, keep the information people rely on accurate, and turn what teams learn into knowledge someone will reuse.

  • Build the view: a clean, reliable portfolio in slides, backed by a tracking system people actually update — assembled with AI so it takes an hour, not a week.

  • Be the honest signal: say early where the plan and reality have diverged, including when the useful version is the uncomfortable one.

What This Role Is Not

You do not make product decisions, approve teams' work, or become a reporting layer between teams and leadership. If teams spend more time updating you than shipping, the role is failing — and you would be the first to say so.

Who You Are

You are the person others trust in a messy week. When priorities shift and work stalls, you stay level, name what is actually happening, and get the loop closed. You follow up without nagging, and an unowned item bothers you until somebody picks it up.


You like order, but you fit the system to the work rather than the other way round. You build trust quickly across designers, engineers and executives, and you carry influence without authority: you move work through people who do not report to you. You are direct enough to raise the awkward problem early, and low-ego enough to let someone else take the credit when it lands.

What You Bring

  • 8 to 10 years running cross-team program execution in digital commerce, technology product management, consumer facing technology, with an earlier career in management consulting.

  • You have owned outcomes across teams without owning the teams. Titles vary — program manager, strategy manager, operations lead, product operations — but the pattern is the same: you were accountable for work you moved through people who did not report to you.

  • Fluent in product work: you know how discovery, design and shipping actually run, and you can talk to designers and engineers without a translator.

  • Comfortable with data and tools: you build a clean portfolio view and a tracking system people trust, and you use AI to do the assembly faster than most.

  • Experience working closely with senior leaders, ideally from an executive office or chief-of-staff environment; experience inside a larger corporate group around a small, fast team is a real advantage.

  • Comfortable at both altitudes: you can run a room of executives in the morning and fix the tracking sheet in the afternoon.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Dutch is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Not a classic PMO profile. We want someone who clears the path, not someone who produces process.

What We Offer

  • Global Impact: Play a crucial role in shaping the future of global commerce. Be part of a dynamic ecosystem of tech-led companies across markets, from emerging disruptors to established platforms, all working to create positive change at scale.

  • Growth Opportunities: Expand your expertise through high-stakes challenges within our diverse portfolio. You will gain access to a network of businesses, leaders, and learning opportunities that span continents and industries.

  • Innovative Culture: Join a forward-thinking team that values strategic insights and bold ideas. You will operate at the intersection of venture-building, innovation, and investment, where experimentation is encouraged and cross-company collaboration drives breakthroughs.

  • Creative Environment: Engage in work that encourages creativity and constant improvement. We challenge assumptions, explore new frontiers, and believe great ideas can come from anywhere in our ecosystem.

  • Collaborative Atmosphere: Benefit from autonomy and self-management in a supportive, outcome-driven workspace. You will work alongside sharp, motivated peers across our portfolio, all united by a shared ambition to move the needle.

  • Hybrid Work: Experience the satisfaction of our flexible model tailored to balance work and life.

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a salary package that reflects your skills and contributions.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: From health and wellness to learning, commuting, and everyday perks, we offer a well-rounded package designed to help you thrive at work and beyond.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout already use Kernel across their enterprise systems.
