jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
jobs.description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Hawk builds AI-powered financial crime detection (AML, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention) for global tier-1 banks, payment processors, and high-growth fintechs. Because our platform analyzes real-time payment streams and sensitive financial data, security is not an administrative support function—it is our primary product promise.

We are looking for a technically grounded, hands-on CISO to own our global security posture end-to-end. This is a true player-coach leadership role. You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs.

Why This Role Matters

  • Global Regulatory Scrutiny at Scale: We operate across key financial hubs including Germany, the UK, the US, Singapore, and a growing roster of international markets. With DORA enforceable across the EU and heightened ICT risk rules globally, our banking clients expect documented operational resilience, continuous testing, and verified controls across all jurisdictions.

  • Modern Attack Surfaces & Supply Chain Threats: Our multi-tenant and single-tenant cloud environments (AWS/GCP) process massive transaction throughput. Alongside defending against emerging supply chain vulnerabilities—from open-source dependencies to third-party build pipelines—you will need to deeply understand our AI approach and actively help harden our tooling, harnesses, and pipelines.

  • Enterprise Deal Velocity: Enterprise security reviews can either stall deals or close them. You will partner with our commercial teams to turn security questionnaires, risk mitigation, and architecture audits into enterprise trust and closed contracts.

Organizational Structure: The Four Domains

You will lead, mentor, and set technical direction for four specialized functional areas:

  1. Application Security: Secure SDLC, automated CI/CD security gates (SAST/DAST/SCA), software supply chain defense, secure coding standards, AI harnesses and pipeline hardening.

  2. Corporate Security: Zero Trust architecture, IAM/SSO, distributed endpoint defense (EDR/XDR), threat hunting, infrastructure access.

  3. Compliance & Governance: DORA implementation, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), multi-jurisdiction regulatory audits, risk registry ownership.

  4. Data Protection: Solely dedicated to data protection: GDPR compliance, privacy governance, data subject rights, and statutory privacy regulatory requirements.

Core Accountabilities

1. Hands-On Technical Leadership, Engineering Integration & AI Hardening

  • Secure Coding Standards & SDLC: Establish and enforce secure coding baselines directly within engineering workflows. Ensure automated vulnerability scanning, SBOM tracking, and security gates are integrated into GitHub/GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

  • Software Supply Chain Defense: Protect build systems, dependencies, and deployment pipelines against supply chain tampering, compromised packages, and upstream vulnerabilities.

  • AI Tooling & Pipeline Hardening: Deeply understand our AI approach and work closely with engineering to harden our systems. Personally evaluate and implement protective mechanisms—including secure AI harnesses, container sandboxing, and runtime guardrails around AI tooling and workflows.

  • Vulnerability Lifecycle Management: Set strict remediation SLAs for CVEs and cloud misconfigurations. Directly arbitrate vulnerability severity, triage zero-days, and collaborate with engineering leads to ensure rapid remediation without stalling release velocity.

  • Zero Trust & Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and drive our group-wide Zero Trust roadmap across AWS and GCP environments, enforcing least-privilege IAM policies, network micro-segmentation, and secure developer access.

2. Commercial Trust & Customer Engagement

  • Peer-to-Peer Customer Dialogue: Act as the senior technical authority in enterprise sales cycles, engaging directly with bank CISOs, InfoSec panels, and procurement leads to validate Hawk's architecture, threat models, and operational controls.

  • Accelerating Enterprise Deal Velocity: Modernize vendor due diligence by replacing reactive security questionnaires with standardized evidence packages, continuous compliance portals, and pre-packaged architectural audits that win customer confidence quickly.

  • Converting Security into a Value Driver: Turn our robust security baseline into a core sales differentiator, helping commercial teams demonstrate to prospect banks why Hawk's defense posture makes us their lowest-risk vendor.

3. Risk Registry, Compliance & Governance Leadership

  • Company Risk Registry Ownership: Act as the executive owner of the company-wide Risk Registry. Go beyond cataloging risks: prioritize exposures dynamically, secure cross-functional executive buy-in to fund and execute mitigations, and transform risk management into concrete business enablement and revenue protection.

  • Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM): Oversee vendor risk tiering, supply chain vetting, and continuous monitoring for third-party vendors and cloud sub-processors, executed directly through the Compliance function.

  • Audit & Regulatory Leadership: Maintain existing ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs with zero major non-conformities across an expanding international perimeter.

  • DORA Implementation: Enforce end-to-end compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act—specifically ICT risk management, third-party vendor oversight, operational resilience testing, and ICT incident reporting.

  • Multi-Jurisdiction Alignment: Adapt policies proactively to meet global financial standards across the EU, UK, US, Singapore, and upcoming expansion markets.

  • Executive & Board Reporting: Translate technical cyber risks into clear business metrics (KRIs, risk heat maps, burn-down rates) for the CEO and Board of Directors.

4. Frontline Incident Response & Operational Resilience

  • First-Hand Incident Commander: Serve as the hands-on incident commander during Sev-1/Sev-2 security incidents. Lead technical investigations, root-cause analyses, log forensics, and technical debriefs directly alongside your team.

  • Breach Notification & External Escalation: Direct regulator, law enforcement, and client communications within mandatory statutory windows under GDPR and DORA guidelines.

  • Testing & Tabletop Drills: Design and execute technical red team engagements, threat-led penetration tests (TLPT), and crisis simulations with both technical engineers and the executive board.

12-Month Success Metrics:

  1. Commercial Velocity: Enterprise bank security assessments clear with zero high-severity blockers, accelerating enterprise contract closures.

  2. Proactive Risk Registry: The company risk registry is fully operationalized with executive buy-in, systematically driving down enterprise risk while supporting business expansion.

  3. Regulatory & Audit Record: DORA compliance program is operational; ISO 27001 and SOC 2 renew cleanly across all operating regions.

  4. Engineering & AI Hardening: Software supply chain security controls, secure coding standards, and AI harness guard rails are fully integrated into engineering CI/CD workflows.

  5. Resilient Team Operations: The four-person security team executes with high autonomy, defined KPIs, and high cross-functional trust across the company.

Candidate Profile:

  • Practitioner Foundations: Proven background as a hands-on security practitioner (e.g., former security engineer, AppSec specialist, cloud security architect, or technical penetration tester) who has advanced into security leadership.

  • Player-Coach Track Record: Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a small team of domain experts while personally reviewing technical configurations, auditing cloud policies, or investigating an alert.

  • Commercial & CISO-to-CISO Fluency: Experience debating architecture, supply chain controls, and threat postures directly with enterprise bank CISOs and security evaluation boards to clear deal roadblocks.

  • AI & Supply Chain Defense Fluency: Ability to quickly understand our AI architecture, implement hands-on controls to harden AI tooling (including AI harnesses and sandboxing), and protect CI/CD pipelines against software supply chain risks.

  • Risk Registry Execution: Demonstrated ability to maintain a living risk registry, articulate risk trade-offs to non-technical executives, and rally engineering and commercial buy-in to remediate risks.

  • FinTech & Regulated SaaS Background: Multi-year leadership experience in a B2B SaaS, FinTech, or banking platform handling sensitive financial or transactional data under regulatory oversight (e.g., DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).

  • Technical Breadth: Strong practical understanding of AWS and GCP security primitives, container and Kubernetes security, modern IAM/SSO, API gateways, and EDR/XDR toolchains.

Bonus:

  • Industry certifications reflecting technical or managerial competence (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP, OSCP).

  • Direct experience securing real-time event-streaming architectures.

  • German language proficiency (conversational or fluent) is a strong advantage.

The role contributes to the Operations 2030 plan with the Transformation Project Team and helps build a common quality logic across processes and sites, based on shared principles, standards, routines and performance measures. 

As Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager your main challenges will be to: 

  • Standardize the Autoreverse process and quality expectations across four Operations sites. 
  • Improve first-time-right performance while protecting safety, throughput and delivery. 
  • Reduce rework, damage, missing parts and process variation. 
  • Build a common performance and quality baseline with comparable data across sites. 
  • Prepare the process for higher volumes, new vehicle architectures and Operations 2030.

1. Process Standards and Methods 

  • Own and maintain the end-to-end Autoreverse standard operating model. 
  • Define standard work, process instructions, checklists and escalation rules for the four sites. 
  • Ensure that process interfaces with scanning, photography, Advanced Services and data preparation are clearly defined. 
  • Identify and deploy practical improvements in methods, tools, workstation organization and flow. 

2. Quality and Continuous Improvement 

  • Define quality criteria and monitor defects, rework, missing components, damage and deviations. 
  • Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action plans with Operations and Quality. 
  • Verify the effectiveness of actions and prevent recurrence through standardization and error-proofing. 
  • Promote a first-time-right culture in all four sites. 

3. Operations Performance 

  • Define and monitor KPIs for safety, quality, lead time, throughput, productivity, rework and cost per vehicle. 
  • Run regular performance reviews with the Operations Managers and escalate risks or gaps. 
  • Use data to prioritize improvement actions and compare performance across sites. 
  • Support daily operations when process or quality issues require technical analysis. 

4. International Coordination and Deployment 

  • Coordinate the consistent deployment of process and quality standards across the four Operations sites. 
  • Build a common operating rhythm for process reviews, audits, lessons learned and action tracking. 
  • Develop and deploy common quality principles, standards, routines and indicators across processes and sites. 
  • Share best practices between sites and support local teams during implementation and ramp-up. 
  • Account for local constraints while protecting the global process standard. 

5. Product and Industrialization Interface

  • Assess the impact of new vehicle architectures, components and product changes on Autoreverse methods and quality. 
  • Provide operational input to new tools, equipment, software, automation and Data Factory initiatives. 
  • Validate that solutions are practical, safe, cost-effective and scalable before wider deployment. 

6. Operations 2030 and Transformation Contribution 

  • Contribute to the Operations 2030 roadmap with the Transformation Project Team and the Global Process Transformation Manager. 
  • Translate transformation priorities into practical process, quality and capability improvements for Autoreverse. 
  • Support POQs and improvement initiatives that can be standardized and deployed across the four sites. 
  • Provide operational feedback on automation, digitalization and Data Factory initiatives. 

7. Team Capability, Safety and Governance 

  • Train and coach teams on standard work, quality requirements and safe operating practices. 
  • Develop competency assessments and practical onboarding for critical Autoreverse activities. 
  • Identify process, quality and safety risks and coordinate mitigation actions. 
  • Maintain clear documentation and ensure that process changes are communicated and implemented.

jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

We are expanding our Product Operations function to help our product organisation scale. As a Product Operations Manager, you will design processes, tools and data infrastructure that improve alignment between Product, Engineering and Go‑To‑Market teams. You will enable seamless collaboration, accelerate feedback loops and coordinate launches, reporting to Gianna Lengyel. The role is based in Paris with a global scope.

What you will do

  • Drive data and analytics – Ensure transparent reporting on customer engagements and product usage; work with Data Science to develop dashboards and insights for product decisions.

  • Manage feedback loops and discovery – Build structured processes to collect and analyse product feedback; run early access programmes and design partner tests.

  • Coordinate launches – Orchestrate product releases and enterprise launches, aligning product managers, marketers, engineers and legal teams.

  • Build product rituals – Shape planning, review and OKR routines; introduce tooling to streamline documentation and knowledge sharing.

  • Maintain product catalogue and documentation – Partner with technical writers to keep documentation current and accessible.

  • Standardise release cycles – Coordinate with Engineering and Science teams to manage release timelines and ensure reliability.

About you

  • 5+ years in product operations, product management or strategy/operations roles (e.g., chief of staff, consulting) in deep‑tech or AI environments.

  • Comfortable working with data and analytics; able to turn usage data and feedback into actionable insights.

  • Strong cross‑functional collaborator; experienced in aligning product, engineering, marketing and sales teams around shared priorities.

  • Process‑oriented mindset; skilled at building repeatable workflows and release processes.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • Fluency in English; French is a plus.

  • Bonus: experience with AI/ML products, pricing and packaging strategies, or consulting/finance backgrounds.

Hiring Process

Our recruitment process is designed to assess your fit for the role and give you a sense of our culture:

  1. Introduction call – 30 min

  2. Hiring manager interview – 30 min

  3. Interview with the product management team – 30 min

  4. Interview with the Solutions team – 30 min

  5. Deep‑dive interview with case study presentation – 60 min

  6. Culture‑fit discussion – 30 min

  7. Reference checks

Location & Remote

The position is based in our Paris HQ offices and we encourage going to the office as much as we can (at least 3 days per week) to create bonds and smooth communication. Our remote policy aims to provide flexibility, improve work-life balance and increase productivity. Each manager can decide the amount of days worked remotely based on autonomy and a specific context (e.g. more flexibility can occur during summer). In any case, employees are expected to maintain regular communication with their teams and be available during core working hours.

 
 

By applying, you agree to our Applicant Privacy Policy.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Über Rotzinger Transver

Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead
jobs.description:
Be yourself at Protolabs 
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification.  We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse team that feels they are valued in the workplace.  So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply!  You can help make our company even better.  We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself.  We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams. 

Why Protolabs? 
We are the leaders in digital manufacturing.  We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit.  Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds.  We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do.  It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home. 

Join our team as a

Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead!

This is a hybrid role, and we are currently considering candidates based in the Netherlands.
 
Protolabs is a digital manufacturing company that turns CAD files and technical drawings into physical parts  fast and at scale. Our AI team builds systems that empower workflows in digital manufacturing such as finding similar parts, geometry understanding, and automated routing of work to the right expert.
 
We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to act as Technical Lead for our horizontal innovation work, the foundational technical building blocks that serve multiple use cases across the value chain.

The work is distinct in that the technology often comes first and the use case follows: this is true innovation, where you prove a capability is possible and then drive it into business value. You will be the single technical point of contact for these initiatives, driving core development of transformative capabilities. You will observe the market, bring new innovations into the organization, and partner across engineering and business teams to turn technology into measurable impact — mentoring and influencing engineers inside and outside your own team without formal authority.

What You Will Do:
Technical leadership & core development
  • Drive core development of transformative capabilities.
  • Take over full technical ownership as the primary technical contact for product management, engineering management, and partner teams on the delivery and roadmap of these initiatives.
  • Create, maintain, and review the technical roadmap together with product and engineering management.
  • Provide architectural guidance for ML systems on inference, agentic approaches and hybrid AI systems; industrialize and maintain proven-value use cases.
    • Technical implementation across a broad range of AI use cases
  • Implement progressive ML solutions for various business domains in agile, crossfunctional teams; rapidly prototype to validate feasibility and value in a scalable manner.
  • Co-develop use cases with domain software teams in temporary cross-functional setups.
    • Market observation & innovation
  • Observe the market and propose new innovations based on technologies emerging outside the company.
  • Evaluate build vs. buy vs. adapt decisions based on cost, effort, risk, and long-term maintainability.
  • Produce written technology-evaluation recommendations (opportunity, feasibility, effort, fit) and find ways to multiply exploration speed by involving other engineers.
  • Identify opportunities where new technology could add business value; hand clear tech ideas to product and business teams to review and validate; identify integration requirements.
    • Cross-organisation delivery & architecture
  • Partner with other engineering teams to deliver business impact through integrating new technologies and new solutions.
  • Draft, share, and align architectural designs for each building block across the organisation, obtaining sign-off from affected teams before integration starts; bring designs to architecture board review.
    • Platform & environment
  • Contribute to foundational environments for (Gen)AI experimentation, model development, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Collaborate with global platform counterparts to implement MLOps, CI/CD, data pipelines, and observability.
  • Advocate for reusable components, shared libraries, and internal tooling to accelerate usecase delivery.
    • Mentoring & influencing
  • Mentor and coach engineers across the organisation — inside and outside your own team— through PR reviews, work scoping, design reviews, and documentation reviews.
  • Proactively surface in-team and cross-team barriers to leadership as they arise, with suggestions on how to resolve them.
  • Identify needs and tech-stack gaps blocking engineers from delivering, and raise them for prioritization.

    • What You Bring:
    Technical
  • 7+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with strong depth in machine learning and deep learning — modeling, data pipelines, evaluation, and shipping models to production using state-of-the-art frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, scikit-learn, XGBoost).
  • Proven ability to build models that serve as autonomous decision systems — applied to critical business problems with large, heterogeneous data.
  • Strong Python engineering fundamentals: clean, modular, testable code; data pipelines; model versioning; CI/CD for ML; packaging for production (e.g. Docker, service wrappers).
  • Solid ML experimentation practice: experiment tracking set up from scratch (e.g. Weights & Biases, MLflow), model evaluation, and iterative improvement tied to measurable business outcomes.
  • Solid understanding of data transformation techniques, languages, and libraries (e.g. Pandas, Polars, SQL, dbt).
  • Familiarity with modern GenAI — LLMs, transformers, vector stores, retrieval techniques (RAG), embedding strategies, and agentic workflows — and GenAI stacks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and OpenAI/Azure/AWS SDKs.
  • Cloud-native, building scalable, secure, and compliant production systems.
  • MLOps background: CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring/observability, IaC, and workflow orchestration (e.g. Prefect, Weights & Biases, or equivalents).
  • Familiarity with backend systems principles, including API serving, containerization, distributed compute, security considerations.
    • Leadership & Collaboration
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technically without formal authority: mentoring engineers, design/PR/documentation reviews, and aligning stakeholders across teams.
  • Experience owning architecture end-to-end: drafting, sharing, and driving sign-off of architectural designs across multiple teams.
  • Experience working in Agile environments — contributing to Scrum ceremonies, breaking work into increments, and collaborating closely with product and engineering management in iterative delivery.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity and early-stage environments; proactive, systematic problem solving.
  • Ability to translate emerging technology into business value — framing opportunities, scoping with product and engineering partners, and identifying integration requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills across global departments: able to align engineers, product/engineering management, and leadership, and to present technical opportunities to both engineering and business audiences.
    • Mindset
  • Builder mentality: pragmatic, resourceful, iterative.
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment while ensuring quality and security.
  • Critical thinking in uncertain or rapidly evolving contexts

    • Bonus Points If You Have :
  • Experience with AWS managed services. 
  • Experience with manufacturing/industrial ML applications. 
  • Experience with geometric/spatial data: point clouds, meshes, voxel grids, or CAD - derived representations. 
  • Experience with vector databases, scalable retrieval architectures, guard railing LLMs, and prompt engineering. 
  • Experience collaborating in international teams across time zones. 

    • What's In It For You:
  • Part of our incredible journey is clearly down to our amazing team, and we strongly believe in giving people a space to truly, authentically be themselves. We also believe that treating our employees well and sprinkling a great place to work with some nice perks can make work a little sweeter.
  • Annual company bonus. We celebrate success together! Employees are not only rewarded for their achievements but also for contributing to the overall success of the business.
  • Wellness and well-being with access to OpenUp psychologists, practice mindfulness with Headspace and tons more.
  • Doggo-friendly office. We are big pet lovers and fully encourage hanging out with your (and your colleagues’) furry friends in the office
  • Daily Lunch and snacks are provided in the office; it's a moment for our teams to connect and recharge. Shared meals strengthen our bonds and fuel collaboration.
  • We offer learning and development days to be used for training or on volunteering, money to spend on learning courses, events, trainings, Access to our in-house LEARN platform with diverse courses, training, and workshops, In-house 3D Printing and much more!
  • Follow us on Instagram to see what Life at Protolabs is all about!

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Your Role

We are looking for a Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a key role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making.

You will build scalable, high-performance data pipelines, ensure data integrity, and contribute to efficient data processing across the organization. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will help develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and apply best practices that empower data-driven decision-making.

This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you help build what comes next. As LIQID scales beyond €4 billion in assets under management, the demands on our data infrastructure are growing fast. You will take real ownership of the pipelines you build, with room to propose solutions and the support to grow your scope.

 

What will keep you challenged?

  • Build, maintain, and optimize scalable data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure efficient, secure, and reliable data processing from source systems to our data warehouse

  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT workflows to integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring seamless ingestion, transformation, and availability

  • Implement data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to guarantee accuracy and integrity for analytics and operational use cases

  • Ensure data security and compliance by applying best practices and industry standards for handling sensitive information

  • Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions that unlock new insights

  • Evaluate and propose new technologies to improve scalability, performance, and future-proof LIQID’s data infrastructure


What you bring

  • 3+ years of professional experience in data engineering or a similar data-related role (e.g., software or analytics engineering with a strong data focus)

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

  • Solid proficiency in SQL, Python and ETL/ELT frameworks, with hands-on experience in data modelling, warehousing, and database management (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL)

  • Experience with at least one cloud data platform (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and modern data pipeline tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt)

  • Good understanding of data modelling principles and of data governance, security, and compliance best practices

  • FinTech experience is a plus, but a strong interest in financial services and data-driven decision-making is essential

  • Experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to speed up development, with the judgment to verify output, not just ship it.

  • Familiarity with data quality testing frameworks or rules-as-code approaches (e.g. dbt tests, Great Expectations) to catch issues before they hit production is a plus.

  • Experience with streaming/near-real-time pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) is a plus.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus


What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget of €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.


What happens next

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

  1. Initial Call with our Talent Partner: A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

  2. Video Interview with Head of Data: You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

  3. Technical Assessment with two Senior Team Members: A technical exchange to discuss your experience and expertise in relation to the role.

  4. In-Person Meeting: You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our CTO.


About us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

 

LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by equal opportunity laws.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Upmarket - EMEA
jobs.description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As Vanta’s Customer Success Manager in the Upmarket space (Enterprise/Mid-Market), you will play a pivotal role in guiding customers through their security and compliance journeys with Vanta's specialised solutions. By combining your customer-centric approach with expertise in Vanta's products and security best practices, you will contribute to the overall success and satisfaction of Vanta's customers in achieving robust security and compliance outcomes through retention of customers and health of the book of business.

Vanta’s success over the last year was exponential, and we are now working to solve the problem of how to provide world-class customer experience to as many security-minded software companies as possible. As Vanta’s Customer Success Manager, you will be the voice of Vanta, responsible for helping keep our customers moving toward their goals and ultimately successful and happy.

What you’ll do as a Customer Success Manager in the Upmarket segment at Vanta:

  • Lead all post-sales activities for Vanta’s customers through onboarding, implementation, product expertise, renewal and identifying upsell opportunities.

  • Partner with Account Managers to drive renewal and expansion opportunities within your book of business.

  • Act as the voice of the customer within Vanta.

  • Serve as the point of contact for your customers and drive them to specific business outcomes on their timelines.

  • Become a product expert on Vanta and how our platform can be used to improve security posture through our compliance offerings (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, USDP and Custom Frameworks), Trust Reports, and Risk Management solution.

  • Provide insightful technical answers and recommend the most efficient way for customers to achieve compliance using our platform.

  • Develop a trusted advisor relationship with key accounts, customer stakeholders, and executive sponsors that may lead to renewals, expansion, and advocacy.

  • Influence Vanta’s strategy and product priorities to drive adoption and retention by being the voice of the customer.

  • Work cross-functionally to resolve customer business issues and work toward mutual goals.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have 6+ years of experience in Customer Success at a SaaS company.

  • Extensive experience with high-end exposure to C-level executives, and the ability to build strong trusted relationships.

  • Providing top-notch account management and relationship building through various means; Quarterly Business Reviews, Health Check Ins, and Executive summaries etc

  • Ability to be nimble and agile in an environment where shifting priorities should be expected.

  • Experience working in the security or compliance industry is preferred.

  • Possess clear and thoughtful communication skills, with strong critical thinking ability.

  • Be highly empathetic to customers, with a proven track record of long-term customer retention.

  • Experience with hitting retention targets and creating happy, healthy customers.

  • Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical customers.

  • Have stellar problem-solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up.

  • Uses AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

    • FYI we are in the office Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

jobs.title: Product Director
jobs.description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

 

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

 

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

 

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

 

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Product Director to help define and build the next generation of Dotfile.

You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Design and our customers to turn complex compliance problems into simple, powerful product experiences. You will own major areas of the product end-to-end: understanding the problem, designing the system, prototyping solutions, shipping with Engineering, and learning from how customers use them.

This is a builder role. You will be expected to go deep into workflows, data models and technical constraints, work directly with engineers and designers, and prototype ideas yourself when that is the fastest way to move forward. You should care as much about how the underlying system works as you do about the user experience built on top of it.

AI is at the core of Dotfile’s product. You will design systems where agents investigate, reason and act across complex compliance workflows, and use AI extensively in your own work to research, prototype and ship faster.

You will lead a small Product team while remaining deeply involved in the work yourself. You will coach and develop the people on your team, raise the bar for product thinking and execution, and create the environment for them to do their best work. This is not a role where management means stepping away from the product.

You will work directly with the CEO and CTO.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Own major product areas end-to-end, from understanding the problem and defining the underlying system to shipping, adoption and iteration

  • Lead and develop a small Product team, setting a high bar for product thinking, execution and ownership while remaining deeply hands-on yourself

  • Turn complex compliance workflows into simple, programmable product experiences that can scale across customers, use cases and jurisdictions

  • Work closely with Engineering and Design on product architecture, data models, workflows and technical trade-offs

  • Design how AI agents interact with data, users and other systems to investigate cases, make recommendations and increasingly automate compliance work

  • Prototype ideas quickly using AI and modern development tools to explore interactions, validate concepts and communicate what should be built

  • Spend significant time with customers and internal teams to understand how compliance actually gets done, identify recurring problems and turn them into scalable product capabilities

  • Define clear measures of product success, use data and customer behavior to evaluate what we ship, and iterate quickly when something is not working

  • Continuously improve how we build product at Dotfile, using AI to accelerate research, analysis, prototyping, specification and execution

 

About you

  • You have 6+ years of experience building software products, including significant ownership of complex B2B or infrastructure products

  • You have experience managing and developing product people, while remaining close to the product and comfortable owning problems directly yourself

  • You are deeply technical for a product leader. You are comfortable discussing APIs, data models, system architecture, integrations and technical trade-offs directly with engineers

  • You think in systems. You naturally look beyond individual features to understand the underlying primitives, abstractions and interactions that make a product scalable

  • You are extremely hands-on. You like getting into the details, exploring data, prototyping ideas and working directly with engineers and designers

For them, a checkout that won’t load isn’t a UX inconvenience. It’s a call home that doesn’t happen. 

Talk360 is profitable, our B2B2C platform is expanding, and we’re building an AI-first engineering team. We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with frontend as their home base: someone who builds excellent web experiences and is just as willing to go into our Rails backend to make them work end-to-end. 

What You'll Do

Work across the stack

Learn from customers, build AI-first

Technical Director, Safety Case
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

Technical Director, Safety Case

🛡️ About our Safety Team

As Technical Director, Safety Case, you’ll own the architecture, strategy and integrity of Wayve’s safety cases for our first products. The role sits independently from Engineering and Product and reports into Safety Management & Assurance, providing senior expert safety oversight while working closely with the teams responsible for designing, developing, validating and releasing our products.

You’ll act as the architect of the safety case—defining the top-level claims, argumentation structure, evidence strategy and assurance approach that connect product intent, system behaviour, AI performance, engineering controls, validation and operational deployment into a coherent safety argument.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll provide independent challenge and advice while enabling Engineering and Product teams to own and deliver the safety evidence required for their systems. You’ll move between top-level safety strategy and detailed technical evidence, identifying gaps and weak assumptions early enough to influence product decisions.

You’ll work across Product, Systems Engineering, AI/ML, Validation, Vehicle Engineering, Software, Hardware and Operational Safety to ensure requirements, architectures, validation plans and release criteria remain aligned with the safety case. You’ll also provide senior leadership and safety governance forums with an independent, evidence-based view of whether the safety argument is sufficiently strong to support release and deployment decisions.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Owning the safety case strategy and architecture for Wayve’s robotaxi and OEM ADAS products.

  • Defining top-level safety claims, argumentation, evidence structures and traceability from safety requirements through validation and deployment decisions.

  • Developing safety arguments appropriate for AI-enabled autonomous driving, incorporating functional safety, SOTIF, AI safety, cybersecurity, validation, operational safety and post-deployment monitoring.

  • Evolving reusable safety case approaches as Wayve’s products, vehicle platforms and evidence base mature.

  • Partnering with Product, Systems Engineering, AI/ML, Validation, Vehicle Engineering, Software, Hardware and Operational Safety to define safety requirements and evidence expectations.

  • Identifying gaps, assumptions and weaknesses in the safety argument early and driving their resolution with accountable teams.

  • Ensuring product requirements, architecture, validation plans and release criteria remain aligned with the safety case.

  • Supporting technical and programme leaders in making proportionate, evidence-based safety decisions.

  • Providing independent technical challenge of safety cases and supporting evidence.

  • Assessing whether safety arguments are coherent, complete, evidence-backed and sufficient to support release or deployment.

  • Highlighting material gaps, uncertainties, dependencies, residual risks and safety red lines, and providing clear recommendations to safety governance forums and senior leadership.

  • Building a common understanding of safety case principles across Wayve and coaching Engineering and Product leaders on structured safety argumentation, evidence quality and traceability.

  • Representing the safety case perspective in internal governance, customer and technical discussions.

  • Contributing to Wayve’s broader safety strategy and assurance capability.

Success in this role means establishing a clear and credible safety case architecture for Wayve’s first robotaxi and OEM ADAS products. Engineering and Product teams will understand the safety claims they support and the evidence they own, while gaps and weak assumptions will be identified early enough to influence product decisions. Wayve’s safety argument for AI-enabled autonomous driving will be technically rigorous, scalable and capable of standing up to scrutiny from customers, regulators and independent assessors.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have deep experience developing or owning safety cases for complex safety-critical systems, ideally within autonomous vehicles, ADAS, robotics, aerospace, defence or another software-intensive domain.

  • You have a strong systems engineering background spanning requirements, architecture, verification, validation and safety assurance.

  • You have demonstrated the ability to translate complex technical evidence into structured safety claims and arguments.

  • You have a strong understanding of autonomous driving and AI/ML safety, including model performance, data, uncertainty and the limitations of conventional verification approaches.

  • You have experience partnering with AI/ML, Engineering, Systems and Product teams on safety-critical products.

  • You have strong knowledge of relevant standards, including ISO 26262, ISO 21448, ISO/PAS 8800 and ISO 3450x.

  • You have excellent technical communication and stakeholder-management skills.

  • You’re an architect and systems thinker who can move comfortably between top-level safety strategy and detailed technical evidence.

  • You’re pragmatic and able to distinguish between what is essential to a safety argument and what is merely desirable.

  • You’re intellectually rigorous, curious and comfortable challenging assumptions, including established industry practices where they do not adequately address AI-enabled autonomous driving.

  • You can operate independently of Engineering and Product without becoming detached from them, providing credible challenge, direction and oversight while helping teams succeed.

  • You’re comfortable operating with uncertainty and can make clear recommendations based on the strength of the available evidence.

  • You’re open to challenge and willing to change your position when better evidence emerges.

  • You can clearly articulate where a safety red line exists, why it matters and what evidence or mitigation would be required to move it.

  • Safety case experience with L2+/L3 ADAS or L4 ADS products is a plus.

  • Experience with GSN or equivalent structured assurance methods is a plus.

  • Safety evidence experience for end-to-end or foundation-model-based autonomous driving is a plus.

  • Experience working with OEMs, regulators, assessors or independent safety reviewers is a plus.

  • Familiarity with operational and post-deployment safety monitoring is a plus.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 – Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  1. Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  2. Competency interviews (Hiring Manager Interview) (45 mins)

  3. Deep-dive interviews (Presentation and Technical Interviews) (2.5 hrs)

  4. Final interview (60 mins)

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you:

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

jobs.title: Client Delivery Lead
jobs.description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY.

Your Role

As a Client Delivery Lead, you're the bridge between customer needs and technical execution in enterprise deals. You translate complex requirements into practical, high-impact solutions, ensuring every proof of concept is accurate, scalable and positioned for success.

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Prefer a lot of structure or close guidance

❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:

  • Prefer fully remote work (this role requires 4+ days per week in the London office)

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
TrustFlight builds software that aviation operators around the world rely on to keep flying safe, for an international customer base with an unusually varied set of problems. This role exists to build and sustain a high-performing team of six to eight engineers: coaching each individual, holding a consistent standard of performance, and owning the process, testing, tooling and infrastructure the team depends on. It is a people and systems leadership role rather than a technical leadership one. Product and the technical leads decide what gets built and how; the Engineering Manager owns the conditions that allow them to build it well and quickly. The postholder is one of four Engineering Managers in a Product, Design and Engineering department of around 40 to 50 people, which is growing and maturing quickly. There is considerable scope here to shape how engineering works across it. 


Key Responsibilities:

  • Raise the performance bar with every hire and every promotion. Treat coaching as a core duty of the role, and upskilling as a standing remit: develop engineers through regular 1:1s, direct feedback, stretch assignments and explicit development plans, and grow technical leads as well as individual contributors. 

  • Manage performance fairly and decisively. Set explicit expectations, recognise strong work, raise problems early and allow runway to respond, and address sustained underperformance promptly. 

  • Act as the chief unblocker for the team across tooling, infrastructure, testing and process, and own the team's infrastructure-as-code estate. Identify the genuine constraints on throughput, including code review latency, slow or flaky tests, handoffs, approval gates and unreliable environments. Remove them, ensure the team can build, test, deploy, observe and recover quickly and safely, and evidence the improvement in flow metrics. 

  • Own testing standards and the consistency of quality across the team, including the definition of “tested”, the criteria that gate a release, and the management of coverage and test flakiness. Quality should not vary according to who wrote the code. 

  • Architect cross-team developer tooling and drive consolidation of the technology estate, jointly with peer Engineering Managers and the Director of Engineering. Build the case for moving from a varied stack onto fewer, better-supported technologies. Establish paved roads and automated guardrails that teams adopt on merit, and sequence the change so that it strengthens delivery. 

  • Work with the technical leads to maintain an accurate and current picture of technical debt, quality and process constraints. Translate it into risks and opportunities the Product Manager can prioritise, so that the balance between product output and technical excellence is a deliberate decision. 

  • Lead the team's adoption of AI-assisted development. Set the standards for where and how AI is used, ensure AI-generated code is understood and accountable to a named engineer, guard against data, licensing and security risk, and maintain an evidence-based view of its effect on the team. 

  • Help establish consistent engineering practice across TrustFlight with the other Engineering Managers. No shared approach to levelling, calibration, feedback and hiring yet exists, and building one is part of this role, so that an engineer's experience does not depend on which manager they report to. 

Required Qualifications & Experience: 

  • At least three years' experience as a dedicated people manager of software engineers, including senior engineers and, ideally, technical leads. 

  • A software engineering background sufficient to contribute credibly in a design review, challenge an architectural decision on its merits, and distinguish a team that feels fast from one that is fast. The postholder will not act as the team's technical lead and will not be assessed on code they write. 

  • Current, practical familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and automated testing, covering Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent, containerised deployment and a major cloud platform, sufficient to own the estate, set standards and review the work. 

  • A track record of raising and holding a quality bar across a team: testing strategy, review standards, and the discipline to keep them consistent as the team and the codebase change. 

  • Demonstrable experience of improving how a team works, supported by evidence of the resulting difference. 

  • Direct experience of performance management, including at least one case of successfully improving, or fairly exiting, an underperformer. 

Desirable Skills & Experience 

  • Practical experience of agentic development setups, using tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, introduced at team or organisation level along with the governance around them. 

  • Experience building or operating auditable agent orchestration systems. A strong advantage, though not a requirement. 

  • A track record of putting AI workflows into real use, and of helping ship AI features in production applications. 

  • An understanding that this field is changing quickly, with the adaptability to keep pace and the credibility to bring a team along on that journey. 

  • Experience leading, or contributing materially to, a technology-stack consolidation across multiple teams. 

  • Experience raising standards across a heterogeneous or inherited technology estate without mandating uniformity. 

  • Experience in a regulated, safety-critical or externally audited software environment, such as aviation, medical, defence or financial services. Valuable, though not a requirement. 

AI & Digital Competency 

TrustFlight is an AI-first organisation. Every role is expected to actively engage with AI tools and digital ways of working to drive efficiency, quality, and innovation. 

 

Tier 3 — AI Builder 

Develops and integrates AI-powered solutions 

Builds, fine-tunes, or integrates AI/ML models and pipelines. Establishes evaluation frameworks for AI systems. Ensures responsible AI practices (fairness, transparency, data governance). Contributes to TrustFlight’s AI strategy. 

 

Role-Specific AI & Digital Skills: 

  • Set and maintain the team's standards for AI-assisted development, covering which tools are approved, where they may and may not be used, and how their output is reviewed. 

  • Ensure AI-generated code entering the codebase is understood and accountable to a named engineer, and that review capacity scales with the volume AI produces. 

  • Apply AI to strengthen testing and documentation, ensuring that AI-written tests validate the requirement and do not simply confirm the behaviour of the implementation. 

  • Establish guardrails against the specific risks of AI-assisted engineering: leakage of customer or regulated data into model context, licensing contamination, and plausible but incorrect code in safety-relevant paths. 

AI Development & Growth 

  • Complete TrustFlight's AI fluency onboarding within the first 30 days. 

  • Dedicate time each month to evaluating emerging AI development tooling and agentic workflows, and pilot promising tools in a controlled way. 

  • Share findings with the Engineering Manager group and the wider engineering team, including negative results. 

  • Contribute to TrustFlight's engineering-wide standards for AI-assisted development, and to the evidence base available to customers and auditors. 

Competencies & Behaviours:

  • People Leadership — Raises the bar with every hire and promotion; coaches deliberately and develops leaders as well as engineers; creates the conditions for people to do their best work. 

  • Fairness and Consistency — Applies the same bar and the same care to everyone; makes reasoning visible; is trusted by engineers and by peers in calibration. 

  • Systems Thinking — Treats delivery problems as problems with the system rather than with the people; identifies the constraint before asking for more effort; takes obstacles off other people's desks and measures success by the team's output. 

  • Technical Judgement — Sufficient depth to ask the right question, weigh a trade-off, and defer to the technical leads when appropriate. 

  • High Standards in a Safety Domain — Holds a consistent quality bar and does not allow defects to pass down the line; recognises that operators' safety cases depend on this software. 

Working Arrangements: 

Working Hours: 

40 hours per week 

Work Pattern:

Hybrid. London-based, with a minimum of two days per week in the London office and the remainder flexible. 

Travel Requirements:

Occasional travel to other TrustFlight locations and to team or company events. Not a regular requirement of the role. 

On-Call / Shift Work:

Not part of the on-call rota. Accountable for the team’s on-call practice being sustainable and fairly shared. 

Special Conditions:

Right to work in the UK. Background screening as required for access to customer and regulated data, including ability to obtain CTC.

jobs.title: Growth Content Strategist
jobs.description:
Contexte

Tu rejoindras l’équipe Brand, au sein du pôle Communication & Contenu de Pennylane.

Notre mission : faire grandir et incarner la marque Pennylane sur l’ensemble de nos canaux, en garantissant la cohérence de notre récit, la qualité de nos contenus et leur pertinence pour nos audiences.

Dans ce cadre, tu travailleras en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe Growth pour concevoir et orchestrer les contenus qui accompagnent nos prospects tout au long de leur parcours : lead magnets, emails, contenus de nurturing et déclinaisons multicanales.

Ton rôle ne se limitera pas à répondre à des demandes de production. Tu devras comprendre les objectifs derrière chaque besoin, proposer les bons sujets et formats, puis organiser leur réalisation. Tu contribueras aussi à structurer nos méthodes de travail et à intégrer l’IA dans nos workflows de contenu, sans compromis sur la qualité.

Tes missions


1. Définir et piloter les contenus Growth

  • Être le point de contact de l’équipe Growth pour ses demandes de contenu : comprendre les objectifs, les audiences et les priorités, puis recommander les formats et angles éditoriaux adaptés.

  • Concevoir et coordonner la production de lead magnets : guides, checklists, livres blancs ou autres ressources utiles à nos audiences.

  • Traiter des sujets variés, liés aussi bien à l’exercice comptable qu’au produit et aux problématiques des entreprises.

  • Construire un plan de déclinaison pour chaque contenu important : identifier ce qui peut être réutilisé, adapté et diffusé sur d’autres supports.

  • Revoir et améliorer les parcours emailing : messages, séquences, cohérence éditoriale et articulation entre les contenus.

  • Concevoir des contenus courts pour alimenter les boucles de nurturing, notamment après le téléchargement d’un lead magnet.

  • Suivre les résultats avec l’équipe Growth, identifier les contenus qui fonctionnent et proposer des améliorations.

2. Orchestrer la production de contenus multicanaux

  • Prendre en charge les demandes de contenu pour le site web (vitrine, pas le produit).

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe SEO sur les besoins de production de contenus (ex : tournages ou relecture).

  • Développer la performance de notre chaîne YouTube : identifier les sujets et formats pertinents, coordonner la production des vidéos, optimiser leur diffusion et analyser leurs résultats pour faire évoluer la stratégie.

  • Contribuer aux témoignages clients : cadrage éditorial, préparation des tournages, coordination de la préproduction et de la postproduction, puis déclinaison des contenus, notamment en ads.

  • Briefer et coordonner les contributeurs internes et externes, assurer les retours et garantir la qualité des livrables.

3. Structurer nos content operations et faire de l’IA un levier de production

  • Mettre en place des façons de travailler simples et efficaces : recueil des demandes, briefs, priorisation, calendrier, suivi de production et validation.

  • Identifier les étapes répétitives ou chronophages et proposer des workflows plus efficaces, notamment grâce à l’IA.

  • Utiliser l’IA pour accélérer la recherche, la préparation des briefs, la rédaction, les déclinaisons et la réutilisation des contenus, selon les besoins.

  • Construire et améliorer des ressources réutilisables : prompts, modèles, guidelines et exemples.

  • Savoir quand utiliser l’IA, et quand ne pas l’utiliser, en gardant la maîtrise de la vérification des faits, du ton, de la pertinence et de la qualité finale.

  • Partager les pratiques qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe et les faire évoluer à partir des retours et des résultats.

Profil recherché

  • Une expérience en content marketing, stratégie éditoriale, content operations ou rôle similaire, idéalement dans un environnement B2B.

  • Un bon jugement éditorial : tu sais choisir un sujet, un angle et un format en fonction d’une audience et d’un objectif.

  • De capacités rédactionnelles irréprochables en français : tu sais écrire clairement, structurer un message et rendre accessibles des sujets parfois techniques.

  • Une bonne compréhension de l’anglais pour évoluer dans une entreprise qui se développe à l’international ; une maîtrise parfaite de la langue n’est pas nécessaire cependant.

  • Une approche très opérationnelle : tu aimes organiser la production, clarifier les demandes, prioriser et faire avancer plusieurs projets en parallèle.

  • Une pratique concrète et curieuse des outils d’IA générative : tu sais les intégrer à ton travail, évaluer leurs résultats et imaginer des workflows utiles à une équipe.

  • Une capacité à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés - website, SEO, brand, ads, experts métier et prestataires - et à challenger un brief lorsque nécessaire.

  • Avoir déjà produit des lead magnets, des campagnes email ou des parcours de nurturing, ou coordonné des contenus vidéo ou des témoignages clients.

  • De l’autonomie, de la rigueur et un bon sens des priorités : tu sais faire avancer les projets sans perdre de vue leur objectif.

  • Un intérêt pour la mesure de l’impact des contenus et l’amélioration continue.

  • Une familiarité avec les sujets comptables, financiers, SaaS ou avec d’autres sujets techniques est un plus.
