Senior Lifecycle & Customer Growth Manager (m/f/d)

Your Mission

Build the next generation of customer growth at Cosuno.

Cosuno is the AI construction platform connecting the European construction industry. Every day, thousands of construction companies use our platform to find partners, publish tenders, submit bids and win contracts. Every interaction generates valuable signals about customer intent, behavior and commercial opportunities.

Your mission is to turn that intelligence into growth.

As our Senior Lifecycle & Customer Growth Manager, you'll own activation, monetization and retention across both sides of our marketplace. Rather than relying on traditional campaign structures, you'll build an intelligent lifecycle ecosystem that continuously adapts to customer needs, marketplace dynamics and business opportunities.

Working alongside our GTM & Growth Engineer, you'll combine customer intelligence, AI, experimentation and automation to fundamentally rethink how CRM operates. As one of the first hires in our growing marketing team, you'll have significant ownership and freedom to shape the function.

What you'll do

Drive customer growth across the marketplace

  • Lifecycle strategy: Own the customer lifecycle across both sides of our marketplace, identifying the biggest opportunities for activation, engagement, monetization and retention.

  • Subcontractor growth: Increase marketplace adoption, Premium conversion, repeat usage and customer lifetime value while reducing churn.

  • Contractor growth: Drive product adoption, marketplace utilization, account expansion and retention, leveraging enriched account data and targeted 1:1 interventions.

  • New growth initiatives: Develop customer loyalty, referral and reactivation programmes that unlock additional growth potential.

Build the next generation of CRM

  • Signal-driven orchestration: Turn product interactions, customer behavior, transactional data and marketplace dynamics into actionable growth signals.

  • Intelligent decision-making: Develop predictive segmentation, customer scoring and Next Best Action frameworks that determine the right intervention, timing, message and channel for each customer.

  • Omnichannel execution: Design, launch and continuously optimize personalized customer journeys across relevant touchpoints, connecting automated communications with human-led interventions from Sales and Customer Success.

Turn customer intelligence into commercial impact

  • Customer intelligence: Independently investigate behavioral patterns, conversion funnels, cohort performance and churn drivers to uncover untapped opportunities.

  • Continuous experimentation: Own a prioritized, hypothesis-driven testing roadmap across messaging, timing, personalization, incentives and intervention logic.

  • Incremental growth: Establish robust measurement frameworks using cohort baselines, A/B tests and holdout groups to understand the actual commercial impact of your initiatives.

Pioneer AI-native lifecycle marketing

  • AI-powered execution: Embed AI across customer analysis, content creation, personalization, segmentation, experimentation and quality assurance.

  • Intelligent automation: Partner with our GTM & Growth Engineer to develop increasingly autonomous lifecycle systems that continuously respond, learn and improve.

  • Operational scalability: Challenge existing processes, eliminate repetitive work and build sustainable workflows that allow the function to scale without a proportional increase in resources.

  • Function building: Establish best practices, shape the lifecycle roadmap and help grow the team over time.

What you bring

We're looking for someone who combines strategic ambition, analytical depth and hands-on execution, with the curiosity to challenge how CRM has traditionally worked.

  • Lifecycle expertise: You've owned CRM, lifecycle or customer growth in a digital business and can demonstrate measurable commercial impact. B2B SaaS or marketplace experience is a plus.

  • Analytical independence: You're comfortable working directly with customer data, investigating behavioral patterns and identifying opportunities beyond existing dashboards.

  • Systems thinking: You approach lifecycle as an interconnected, adaptive ecosystem rather than a collection of individual campaigns.

  • Technical fluency: You understand CRM architecture, product events, tracking, segmentation and automation, and can translate commercial requirements into technical solutions.

  • Applied AI experience: You've integrated AI and intelligent automation into real marketing workflows, beyond content generation.

  • Experimental mindset: You challenge assumptions, understand incrementality and prioritize initiatives based on evidence and commercial potential.

  • Builder mentality: You're proactive, ambitious and comfortable creating structures where none exist yet, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: You're equally comfortable working with engineers, Product, Sales and Customer Success.

  • Fluent English: German is a strong plus, as is experience with ActiveCampaign or Salesforce.

Your Benefits

  • Room to shape and grow: Build an intelligent customer growth function, with ownership across both sides of a dynamic marketplace.

  • Dedicated engineering support: Work alongside a GTM & Growth Engineer to turn ambitious lifecycle concepts into scalable technical solutions.

  • AI at the core: Our product already uses AI to analyze millions of construction price data points. We're bringing that same ambition to how we operate internally.

  • Competitive compensation: Above-market salary and a permanent contract in a stable, well-funded technology company.

  • Flexibility: Fully remote or from our Berlin Kreuzberg office, with flexible working hours.

  • Top equipment: A new MacBook Pro and access to the latest tools.

  • A great team: An ambitious, international team with regular off-sites, team events and an open feedback culture.

  • Professional growth: Regular development conversations and the opportunity to shape and grow your own function.

About Cosuno

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, yet much of it still runs on fragmented information, spreadsheets and manual processes.

We're changing that.

Cosuno combines an intelligent marketplace, proprietary industry data and artificial intelligence to transform how construction companies find partners, manage tenders and award contracts.

Join us and build the future of construction.

Senior Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

About the role

You’ll join an AI-native engineering team where AI is central to how we design, build and ship software. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who understands software deeply, uses AI to build better software faster, and wants to help improve how the whole team works.

You will own projects from understanding the customer problem to shipping a solution and improving it in production. Working closely with engineering and product, you will help decide what we build, how we build it, and where to invest as the platform grows.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. Your focus will reflect your strengths and the team’s priorities, whether that means building product experiences, developing backend services, or solving challenges across the platform. We value engineers who bring depth in their area and curiosity beyond it.

What you’ll do

  • Own projects from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment and follow-up.

  • Work closely with product and other engineers to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions and turn complex requirements into clear, usable software.

  • Build and improve the interfaces, APIs and services that financial institutions rely on for their compliance operations.

  • Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing delivery speed with reliability, security and maintainability.

  • Investigate production issues and improve performance, observability and resilience as the platform grows.

  • Raise the engineering bar through knowledge sharing and improvements to how we develop and ship software.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our platform as we build more AI-powered compliance capabilities.

About you

  • You have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and maintaining software in production.

  • You understand software in depth. You bring strong fundamentals and depth in backend or full-stack development. You can reason about data, concurrency, performance and failure modes, and investigate unfamiliar systems beyond the surface.

  • AI coding agents are central to how you work. You use tools such as Codex or Claude Code extensively to explore, build, test and review software. You keep experimenting with ways to make yourself more effective.

  • You bring the judgment that makes AI-assisted development work. You frame problems clearly, provide useful context, challenge assumptions and verify the resulting behavior. You can explain why a solution works and take responsibility for what you ship.

  • You take ownership. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a practical plan, follow through on delivery and improve the result in production. You are comfortable learning new technologies and working beyond your usual area when a problem calls for it.

  • You care about the product as much as the implementation. You want to understand who you are building for, challenge requirements when needed and assess whether your work solves the original problem.

  • You value simple, well-designed solutions. You know when to move quickly and when reliability, security or long-term maintenance require more care.

  • You communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating. You explain your technical choices, welcome constructive disagreement and share what you learn with your teammates.

  • You want to help shape an AI-native engineering team. You enjoy improving how software gets built, from reusable agent workflows to better testing and feedback loops, and turning your own discoveries into practices that make the whole team more effective.

Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech or compliance is a plus.

Our technology

Our main language is TypeScript. Our stack includes:

  • Frontend: React, Apollo GraphQL and Storybook.

  • Backend: Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL and PostgreSQL.

  • Infrastructure: AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Development and testing: Nx, GitLab CI, Playwright.

You do not need experience with every part of our stack. We care about your engineering judgment, your ability to learn and the quality of the software you build.

Why join us

  • Join a company with traction and room to shape its future. With 100+ financial institutions using Dotfile and a recent Series A, you’ll help define the next stage of the product and engineering team.

  • Help shape how an AI-native team works. Experiment with new approaches, improve your own workflow and turn what you learn into practices that make the whole team more effective.

  • Put your engineering depth to work. Solve demanding problems in automation, AI, data and reliability, building software that financial institutions depend on every day.

  • Have a direct say in what you build. Influence technical decisions, own projects through to production, and see how your work changes the customer experience.


Our hiring process

  1. CTO conversation — 30-60 minutes : Discuss your background, explore the role and how our engineering team works, and answer technical questions to assess your engineering knowledge and problem-solving approach.

  2. Case study — 60 minutes : Design the architecture of a project we provide, or present the architecture of a past project you led. Walk us through your reasoning, technical decisions and trade-offs.

  3. Raise the bar — 30 minutes: Meet someone from Product or Solutions Consulting to discuss how you collaborate across teams, understand customer needs and approach problems together.

  4. Founder discussion — 15-30 minutes: Meet our CEO to discuss Dotfile’s ambition, what motivates you and the contribution you could make.

jobs.title: Clinical Lead, Women's Health
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

💜 The role

Women's bodies are different, yet medicine still treats them the same. Women get diagnosed about 4 years later than men on average across 700+ types of disease. In France, 51% of women say a health professional has played down their symptoms at least once.

We want to change that. We are building the health system women never had: one that listens to women, anticipates their needs at every stage of life instead of waiting for problems to appear, and gives them care they can trust. To do this, we combine the latest evidence, digital tools, AI and carefully selected health professionals with our strength as an insurer.

We are looking for a doctor who wants to do medicine differently: to build products that thousands of women use and that address their needs; to move care towards prevention; and to work every day with people who think differently, such as product managers, designers, engineers and marketers.

As our Clinical Lead for Women's Health, you make this clinically credible and effective. You own the clinical choices, and you are an essential and active contributor in the product team.

A few things to know before you apply

  • This is a clinical role inside a product team, at an early stage. You own the clinical choices and you build the product with project builder, engineers, designers, ... A good product combines many factors, and the clinical side is one of them. There is a lot to build, to test and to change, and not everything is proven yet. For example, we measure how much our services are used much better than the health outcomes they achieve: building that measurement, honestly, is part of the job.

  • You work outside the usual medical world. Most of your colleagues are not health professionals. You will confront perspectives, explain clinical constraints in simple words, listen to product and business constraints, and find solutions together. Decisions are discussed and made as a team.

  • It takes real time. We prefer 80% or more; at least 60% is possible.

What you will do

You will be the clinical lead of our Women's Health offer, and you will help turn it into a product that women use and trust.

  • Build the product with the team. Work closely with product managers, designers and engineers, and bring the clinical view early, when it shapes decisions, not at the end. With AI tools, you can also build simple things yourself, without knowing how to code.

  • Own the clinical choices. Define our clinical positions based on evidence, design protocols and care pathways, and hold a few clear, explained red lines. When something doesn't work, you help find a safe and relevant alternative.

  • Make our AI safe and accurate on women's health. Work with the product team on how Mo, our AI-powered health companion, handles women's health topics, and help evaluate and improve it.

  • Show the value for women. Help define how we measure the impact on women's health, using evidence-based tools and value-based healthcare principles.

  • Work with our Clinic team. Work hand in hand with Alan's doctors, midwives and other health professionals: help train and support them, and be the person they turn to for difficult cases.

  • Feed and endorse our medical communication. Make sure what we say about women's health is accurate and evidence-based, and help explain it in simple words. Over time, you may represent Alan on these topics.

What success looks like in 6 months

  • Product: you are a core member of the product team, and the first member journeys reflect your clinical input from the start.

  • Protocols in use: the clinical protocols and care pathways of our first women's health program are validated and applied by the Clinic team.

  • Clinic team: midwives and doctors on the program are trained on the protocols, clinical staffing is under way, and you supervise complex cases.

  • Health outcomes: the program's health outcomes are defined and tracked.

  • AI quality: you have helped us make sure our AI handles women's health safely and accurately.

What this role is not

  • Not a medical advisor or reviewer who comes in at the end, nor the person who decides alone.

  • Not the person who runs all the consultations: our midwives and doctors do that, and you design, pilot and supervise.

  • Not an expert on every topic: you bring in other health professionals when needed.

A dynamic, international community of health professionals

You don't work alone. You join Alan's health professionals community: a large network of doctors, midwives, psychologists and other clinicians in France, Spain, Belgium and Canada, and a small core team of Alaners, other clinical leads working on different health programs or services. It is a community with high standards, direct and caring feedback, and a lot of room to shape things.

Beyond Women's Health, you will:

  • Share your practice and learn from others through case reviews and community sessions;

  • Help set common standards across programs;

  • Help welcome, train and mentor new health professionals joining Alan;

  • Help other teams at Alan understand key health concepts, such as evidence-based care;

  • Over time, contribute to other health topics beyond Women's Health.

👀 Is it you we're looking for?

Must-haves

  • You are a gynecologist (OB-GYN) or a GP with solid training in women's health, for example a university diploma (DU or DIU) in gynecology, or several years of regular gynecological follow-up in your practice. You can come from private practice, a hospital, a clinic or a health tech company.

  • At least 5 years of post-residency experience, with solid clinical judgment and evidence-based prescribing.

  • Clinical experience across several areas of women's health, for example contraception, fertility, endometriosis, menopause or hormone treatments.

  • An open, pragmatic mindset: you enjoy working with non-medical teams, you make trade-offs when they are legitimate while defending evidence-based rigor, and you are curious about what AI and digital tools change in medicine.

  • Outcomes thinking: you care about the results that matter to patients compared with what care costs (value-based healthcare), and about prevention, not only treatment.

  • A great understanding of the French healthcare system.

  • Fluency in both French and English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience training or supervising other health professionals is a plus, and a collaborative approach with midwives, dietitians, therapists, …

  • Experience in digital health, a start-up, a healthcare project or teleconsultation.

  • Experience writing or contributing to a clinical protocol or guideline.

🤝 How we work

  • Contract: you join Alan as an employee, ideally at 80% or more, and at least 60%. You can keep some clinical practice outside Alan.

  • Team: you are part of the Women's Health product team and of Alan's health professionals community.

  • Location: our headquarters are in Paris. You can be based abroad, as long as you speak French fluently and know the French healthcare system well.

  • Remote work: we offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration.

🔄 What to expect from our recruitment process

  1. Application Review: we read your CV and application.

  2. Screening interview (45 to 60 minutes): your path, your motivation for this role, and practical points such as your availability.

  3. Technical interview: a short written case at home (60 to 90 minutes), including a situation where clinical and product needs conflict, then a live discussion of your answers.

  4. Alaner Fit interview: a conversation about how we work at Alan and whether it suits you.

  5. Alan Day: an on-site day where you prepare concrete use cases, present them to a panel and meet the people you would work with.

  6. Reference calls, including at least one with a non-medical colleague you have worked with.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

💡 You want to know more about Alan?

  • Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work.

  • Check out our About Alan and Career pages for more info.

jobs.description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Au sein d’IMT Mines Albi, la Direction de la Recherche, du Doctorat, de l’Innovation et de l’Entrepreneuriat (DRDIE) définit et porte la stratégie scientifique, d’innovation et d’entrepreneuriat de l’école. Elle coordonne les moyens nécessaires à sa mise en œuvre, de la recherche amont à sa valorisation en innovations pour les filières industrielles, veille à leur adéquation avec les ambitions fixées et s’assure de la bonne exécution par les centres, qui contribuent à la dynamique collective.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

En qualité de Responsable de la Valorisation & Accompagnement Deeptech, et sous la responsabilité du Directeur Adjoint Recherche, Doctorat, Innovation & Entrepreneuriat, vous portez l’offre de valorisation de technologies et d’entrepreneuriat deeptech de l’école. Vos principales missions consisteront à :

·         développer le portefeuille de technologies à valoriser issues des résultats de recherche des centres et des partenaires ;

·         convertir ces technologies en transferts vers des entreprises installées ou en création ;

·         promouvoir l’offre « valorisation de technologies & entrepreneuriat deeptech » ;

·         former et accompagner les personnels de recherche dans la conversion des résultats de recherche en innovations, les entrepreneurs dans leur projet de création d’entreprise technologique et les étudiants dans le domaine de l’innovation, dans le cadre de leur formation initiale.

Dans ce cadre, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

Développer le portefeuille de technologies à valoriser

·         structurer et piloter l’activité : analyse tactique, définition du process et des outils, actions opérationnelles, suivi de la performance, animation d’un réseau d’experts et mesure de la satisfaction ;

·         organiser et professionnaliser l’« Innovathon », dispositif de valorisation de la recherche à destination des filières industrielles, hybridé avec la formation à l’innovation et à l’entrepreneuriat ;

·         alimenter le catalogue de technologies à potentiel issues des centres et des partenaires de l’écosystème : construire le modèle, identifier et mobiliser les acteurs internes et externes, assurer le sourcing des résultats de la recherche, caractériser leur potentiel et proposer le mode de valorisation le plus pertinent.

Convertir ces technologies en transferts vers des entreprises installées ou en création

·         structurer et piloter cette activité de transfert selon la même démarche (process, outils, suivi de la performance, réseau d’experts, satisfaction) ;

·         développer les dispositifs de prospection auprès des clients industriels pour le transfert des technologies du portefeuille ;

·         identifier et activer les sources de financement utiles à l’activité ;

·         initier des projets de (pré)maturation de ces technologies, ou de transfert vers des candidats à la (pré)incubation et vers les industriels.

Promouvoir l’offre « valorisation de technologies & entrepreneuriat deeptech »

·         mobiliser les réseaux institutionnels, académiques et industriels afin de recruter des candidats aux parcours de (pré)incubation, de repérer des technologies à valoriser et d’identifier des prospects industriels ;

·         concevoir et organiser les événements annuels dédiés à la valorisation, à l’innovation et à l’entrepreneuriat ;

·         organiser les animations de l’« Espace Start-Up Territorial ».

Accompagner les personnels de recherche, selon leur maturité, dans la conversion des résultats de recherche en innovations

·         sensibiliser les personnels de recherche à la valorisation et à l’entrepreneuriat, avec une attention particulière pour les doctorants et post-doctorants ; coordonner les dispositifs internes dédiés ainsi que la participation aux dispositifs de l’écosystème ;

·         organiser, en coordination avec RED, un parcours valorisant et incitatif de sensibilisation, de formation et de détection dédié aux doctorants ;

·         identifier et « recruter » les chercheurs-valorisateurs (doctorants, personnels temporaires de recherche, personnels permanents) pour des projets de valorisation ou d’incubation ;

·         déployer des actions de mise en visibilité des chercheurs-valorisateurs.

Accompagner les entrepreneurs dans leur projet de création d’entreprise technologique

·         opérer l’un des deux parcours étudiant-entrepreneur du programme de pré-incubation et proposer des pistes d’amélioration ou de complément ;

·         accompagner les incubés, selon leur maturité, avec un focus fort sur la définition et la validation du besoin des cibles identifiées, de la proposition de valeur et du marché applicatif, sur le design fonctionnel de la solution et sur la consolidation de l’équipe porteuse du projet de création ;

·         les accompagner dans le montage de collaborations avec les centres et dans la recherche de financements.

Piloter le module de sensibilisation à l’innovation « Dynamiques d’innovation et entrepreneuriat » (IFIE1)

·         concevoir la maquette pédagogique et coordonner son déploiement ;

·         ancrer le module dans le continuum innovation & entrepreneuriat, dans une perspective de recrutement pour le parcours étudiant-entrepreneur.

 

Le poste nécessite des déplacements de courte durée, ainsi que l’organisation ou la participation à des événements en soirée.

 

CAPACITÉ ET ATTITUDES :

·         Vous disposez des compétences, connaissances et expériences suivantes :

o    maîtrise des approches et postures d’accompagnement dans le domaine de l’entrepreneuriat ;

o    approches structurantes de créativité et de conception innovante centrée utilisateurs ; approches de résolution de problèmes ;

o    méthodologies et outils de gestion de projets de recherche ou d’innovation ;

o    connaissance de l’écosystème institutionnel et académique de la recherche, de l’innovation et de la création d’entreprise ;

o    maîtrise des financements publics et privés dédiés à la valorisation de la recherche et à l’entrepreneuriat ;

o    maîtrise des processus de création et de développement d’une start-up, et bonne connaissance du processus de création d’une offre produit ; approche processus ;

o    capacité à déployer une approche d’accompagnement en entrepreneuriat, à commercialiser une offre B2B, à construire et développer un portefeuille de produits et à élaborer un plan de promotion de l’activité ;

o    capacité à déployer une méthode de créativité structurante, à analyser ou élaborer une roadmap produit et à mobiliser les réseaux ;

o    capacité à évaluer et hiérarchiser les besoins pour maîtriser la charge d’activité, et à gérer les aléas ;

o    aisance dans les échanges en anglais.

·         Les caractéristiques suivantes vous ressemblent :

o    organisation dans la conduite de votre activité et capacité à rendre compte de façon différenciée et adaptée à la situation ;

o    force de proposition et prise d’initiative ;

o    posture d’accompagnant adaptée au niveau de maturité du bénéficiaire ;

o    capacité de compréhension et d’influence d’écosystèmes complexes ;

o    aptitude à analyser des objets technologiques dans une perspective applicative, en réponse à un besoin utilisateur ;

o    adaptabilité aux différents interlocuteurs et situations dans un écosystème interculturel, politique et complexe ;

o    méthode, rigueur et fiabilité d’exécution.

 

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

·         Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master II et bénéficiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de la recherche et de l’innovation.[1]

 

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

  • Un cadre de travail agréable sur un campus de 22 hectares ;

  • un forfait cadre avec 49 jours de congés annuels (congés + RTT) ;

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Business Partner
jobs.description:
As a Talent Acquisition Business Partner, you'll play a key role in attracting and hiring the talent that drives Tellent's growth. You'll own end-to-end recruitment across different business functions, from Product & Engineering to Go-to-Market, partnering with hiring managers to develop effective hiring strategies and deliver a great candidate experience.

Talent Acquisition is a dedicated function within our wider People Team. You'll work closely with hiring managers, HR Business Partners and other People colleagues to understand business priorities and translate them into recruitment strategies.

We're looking for an all-round recruiter who combines strong sourcing skills with a genuine business partnering mindset. Someone who isn't afraid to challenge hiring requirements, question assumptions and bring market insights to the table. As internal users of our own products, you'll also collaborate with our Product teams to share feedback and identify opportunities to improve our recruitment tools and experience.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During the first 3 months: Get familiar with our business, teams and recruitment processes. Build relationships with key stakeholders and take ownership of active recruitment processes.

  • Within 6 months: Independently manage recruitment across multiple functions, develop sourcing strategies and build talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

  • After 1 year: Become a trusted business partner to hiring teams, contribute to talent acquisition strategy and drive continuous improvements across our recruitment processes and tools.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own end-to-end recruitment: Manage the full recruitment lifecycle across different functions, from intake meetings and sourcing to offer management.

  • Partner with the business: Work closely with hiring managers and HR Business Partners to understand business needs and develop effective hiring strategies.

  • Challenge and advise: Question hiring requirements, challenge assumptions and bring talent market insights to hiring decisions.

  • Drive proactive sourcing: Identify and engage active and passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals and other channels.

  • Build talent pipelines: Develop and maintain talent pools for current and future hiring needs.

  • Improve how we work: Monitor recruitment performance, identify opportunities for improvement and collaborate with our Product teams to share feedback as an internal user of Tellent.

What You Bring

  • Several years of experience in Talent Acquisition or recruitment, ideally in an in-house environment.

  • Experience managing end-to-end recruitment across different functions, ideally covering both Product & Engineering and Go-to-Market roles.

  • Experience in a B2B SaaS, technology or fast-growing scale-up environment is a strong plus.

  • Strong sourcing skills and experience building talent pipelines, including engaging passive candidates.

  • Confidence in partnering with and constructively challenging hiring managers and senior stakeholders.

  • A good understanding of talent markets and the ability to translate business needs into realistic hiring strategies.

  • A proactive, hands-on mindset with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms.

  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working from our canal-side Amsterdam office

  • Diverse and international team environment

  • €1,500 annual learning budget + 2 dedicated learning days

  • Pension plan, wellness perks & commuting/travel reimbursement

  • 28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days in 2026

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year

  • Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed

  • €200 home office budget + work-from-home allowance

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

AI in our recruitment process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

jobs.title: Senior Art Director (m/f/d)
Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.


⚖️ About our Legal Team

Wayve’s Legal Team enables the business to achieve its goals while appropriately identifying and managing legal risk. This role sits within our Commercial Legal team, reports to the Managing Counsel, and will play an important role as Wayve scales globally and brings embodied AI technology into real-world deployment.

Based in London, you’ll work closely with commercial, procurement, engineering, product, privacy, People and Fleet Operations teams on a broad range of commercial and cross-border matters. You’ll have significant ownership and autonomy, helping stakeholders understand legal and commercial risks and finding practical paths forward in areas where precedent and market practice may still be developing.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll independently manage a broad range of day-to-day commercial legal matters while partnering closely with colleagues across the business. You’ll draft and negotiate agreements, advise on IP, AI, data, privacy and employment matters, and support strategic initiatives, international expansion and new product deployments.

This is an opportunity for a commercially minded lawyer who enjoys working at the intersection of law, AI, product innovation and operational scale. You’ll need to be comfortable exercising judgement in a fast-moving environment, clearly communicating risk and helping the business find solutions rather than simply identifying obstacles.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating a broad range of commercial agreements, from supplier, software/SaaS, services and other operational contracts through to bespoke agreements with OEM customers and Tier 1 suppliers involving significant IP, data, privacy and other technology-related issues.

  • Advising on intellectual property, AI and data usage, including data used for AI development and training, alongside other members of the Legal team and external counsel where required.

  • Working through novel and emerging legal questions at the intersection of law and AI, including areas where legal frameworks, precedent and market practice are still developing.

  • Advising the People team on employment and HR matters relating to Wayve’s global workforce, working with local counsel where specialist jurisdictional advice is required.

  • Advising on data protection and privacy, including the use and sharing of data in connection with Wayve’s products, commercial relationships, and AI development and training.

  • Supporting strategic initiatives, international expansion and new product deployments from a commercial legal perspective.

  • Supporting Fleet Operations and other operational teams in connection with the operation, testing and deployment of Wayve’s vehicle fleet across international markets.

  • Building and improving scalable legal processes, templates, playbooks and governance structures to support Wayve’s growth and increasing contracting volume.

  • Educating and enabling stakeholders on commercial risk, contracting best practices and legal processes, while supporting other members of the Legal team.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You are a qualified solicitor in England and Wales.

  • You trained at a leading law firm and have approximately 2–4 years of relevant post-qualification experience, although we are open to candidates with more or less experience.

  • You have strong experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements, including procurement, supply chain, technology and vendor contracts.

  • You are comfortable negotiating directly with commercial counterparties and can communicate legal positions clearly and pragmatically.

  • You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills and can distil complex legal issues into clear explanations of legal and commercial risk for non-legal stakeholders.

  • You have experience supporting strategic commercial transactions and working closely with business stakeholders in fast-moving, technology-driven environments.

  • You exercise strong commercial judgement, assessing legal risk in the context of broader business objectives and providing practical, solutions-oriented advice.

  • You have experience advising on employment matters affecting a global workforce, or are willing to develop experience in this area, including navigating a fast-paced employment environment.

  • You can operate autonomously on day-to-day matters, take initiative and exercise sound judgement about when to escalate.

  • You have experience partnering cross-functionally and can communicate effectively with both legal and non-legal experts.

  • You have strong organisational and prioritisation skills and can manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities.

  • You’re enthusiastic about getting stuck into a broad range of legal matters, including areas outside your existing experience, and are comfortable tackling novel questions where precedent may be limited.

  • Experience within automotive, mobility or the broader technology sector is a major plus, particularly at an OEM, Tier 1 supplier or similarly complex engineering-led organisation.

  • Experience supporting OEM, strategic partnership or other large-scale B2B transactions involving hardware, software, data or integrated technology solutions is a plus.

  • Exposure to AI, data or autonomous vehicle-related legal issues is a plus.

  • Cross-border commercial advisory experience across the UK, US, Europe and Japan is a plus.

  • Experience supporting commercial or employment matters in Germany, including familiarity with the German legal and regulatory environment and working with German stakeholders and local counsel, is a plus.

  • Experience helping automate and scale legal processes, templates or commercial legal functions is a plus.

Experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics or AI would be valuable, but it is not essential. We are most interested in strong foundational commercial skills, sound judgement and a proven ability to navigate complex legal landscapes in a fast-moving environment.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 – Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our London office. Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

Some international travel may be required.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency interviews (Hiring Manager Interview and team interview) (90 mins)

  • Deep-dive interviews (Presentation) (60 mins)

  • Final interview (30 mins)

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable

📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

  • Observability platforms such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana or Datadog

  • NVIDIA Orin or Thor compute platforms

  • Qualcomm compute platforms

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay. If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalize and improve at scale.

Instead of relying on hand-coded rules or pre-mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency.

We believe autonomy represents a once-in-a-generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars and from human-driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2+ through to L4 as our core AI model scales.

In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real-world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach: building generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer and more intelligent future of mobility.

💻 How we work—location and flexible working

This is a full-time role based in our London office.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated offices and workshops with focused time working remotely.

We also operate core working hours, allowing you to determine the schedule that works best for you and your team. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together alongside the flexibility to do their best work.

🔍 The interview process

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial recruiter conversation

  • Competency interviews — Leadership & Management and Runtime Platform Domain interviews; approximately two hours in total

  • Deep-dive interviews — Hiring Manager, Software Systems Design and Code Review interviews; approximately three hours in total

  • Final interview — mission and values alignment; approximately one hour

We’ll explain each format in advance and work around your availability.

Wayve is committed to creating an inclusive interview experience. If you require any accommodations or adjustments to participate fully in the process, please let us know.

What’s in it for you?

📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long-term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable

📚 Learning and development budgets, with support for training, conferences and professional growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits, including health insurance, dental coverage, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension support where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

 

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

As the team leader (a player-coach role), you’ll manage Product Support Analalyts in Europe and spend roughly 40% of your time directly owning customer issues and our most complex escalations. This role owns live customer-impacting incidents for enterprise pharma and biotech customers, helps shape an AI-first support model, and sits close to CX leadership. Working closely with our Global Support and CX Leadership Teams, you’ll combine team leadership, incident management, and thoughtful AI adoption to help scale a modern, efficient Support organization.

  • Analyze support metrics (volume, severity trends, time-to-resolution, comms timeliness) to inform staffing and process decisions, and report trends to CX leadership.

Able to personally troubleshoot and resolve complex customer issues.

Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field recommended (biology, microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, neurology, etc.); research or lab experience is a big plus.

Constructor helps e-commerce businesses connect shoppers with the products they want through AI-powered search and product discovery.

We’re looking for an experienced Retail Media sales professional to help grow our business across EMEA. You’ll work with retailers to understand their monetisation ambitions, build compelling business cases and sell technology that helps them develop and scale their Retail Media offering.

Own Retail Media opportunities from discovery to close

  • Identify and qualify opportunities with retailers looking to launch, improve or scale their Retail Media business.

  • Understand each retailer’s commercial model, advertiser demand, inventory and operational readiness.

  • Understand the relationship between retailer economics and the needs of brands, sellers and agencies.

  • Partner with Account Managers on Retail Media expansion opportunities within existing customer relationships.

  • Share discovery frameworks, objection handling, business-case approaches and lessons from live deals.

  • Help develop a repeatable Retail Media sales motion across EMEA.

  • Ensure closed opportunities move into delivery with clear commitments, ownership and success criteria.

  • Share customer feedback, competitive insights and emerging buying requirements with Product and leadership.

You build a qualified pipeline, develop strong customer business cases and convert opportunities into commercial partnerships. Customers understand both the growth opportunity and what it will take to realise it.

You own procurement at Camunda end to end: strategy, process, systems and the commercial outcome of our largest vendor relationships. This is a hands-on leadership role. You negotiate the big contracts yourself, set how we buy, and build a small, AI-first team that scales with the company.

What You Will Do:

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

The Technical Account Manager owns the day-to-day operational relationship with operator and aggregator clients from go-live onward. They give each client a single technical contact who knows their setup, freeing Account Management to focus on commercial growth. They are accountable for the quality of client configurations and for making changes quickly and accurately, within the standards set by Operations and Compliance, escalating any exceptions.

This is not a commercial, first-line support or approval role: the TAM carries no revenue target, handles complex and recurring tickets rather than all of them, and follows published configuration standards rather than setting them.

Responsibilities

Client ownership after go-live

  • Act as the primary technical and operational contact for newly onboarded clients.
  • Act as the main stakeholder on integration channels after go-live, picking up operational requests and routing anything commercial to the Account Manager.
  • Monitor the period after go-live for latency and early signs of problems that would affect a successful launch, and escalate before the client reports them.
  • Manage key accounts from an operational perspective, supporting clients through changes to their setup.

Operational configuration and change

  • Own financial limit changes and RTP updates, applying the current Booming standards and escalating any request that falls outside them.
  • Own tournament configuration where this sits with Customer Success rather than with the Account Manager.
  • Handle general client requests such as media files and thumbnails, which clients may now request directly from the TAM.
  • Handle setup changes: new currencies, new configurations, account migrations and account splits.

Issue resolution and escalation

  • Handle daily operational queries and lead the resolution of higher complexity issues across Operations, Platform and SRE.
  • Keep the client informed in plain language during an incident, with content routed through the agreed communication channel.
  • Translate operator needs into clear, prioritised internal requests that an engineer can act on without a second conversation.

Process and improvement

  • Monitor internal operational processes: ticket flow, SLAs, escalation paths and release communication.
  • Identify recurring issues and gaps, propose improvements, and implement the ones that are agreed.
  • Keep the client-facing operational documentation current for the accounts in scope.

Requirements

Experience

  • 3+ years in a technical account management, technical support or operations role in B2B software, ideally iGaming or another integration-heavy environment.
  • Experience owning client relationships after go-live, including incident communication to a demanding counterparty.
  • Experience working to SLAs and defending them internally.

Technical

  • Comfortable with APIs, integration patterns and reading logs well enough to triage before escalating.
  • Able to work in a ticketing and documentation stack (Jira, Confluence) and in internal configuration tooling.
  • Able to read and sanity-check configuration data: game options, limits, currencies, jurisdiction settings.
  • SQL or equivalent query ability is an advantage, for checking a claim before raising it.

Communication

  • Writes clearly under pressure, in a way that does not create commitments the company has not made.
  • Holds a position with a client when the answer is no, and escalates rather than improvising an exception.
  • Works across Account Management, Operations, Platform and Compliance without owning any of them.

Nice to have

  • iGaming operator or aggregator integration experience.
  • Familiarity with regulated market configuration differences across jurisdictions.
  • Experience improving a support or operations process and measuring the result.

Good to know

What does success in the first 6 months looks like:

  • Named operator accounts have a single technical contact and a documented, current setup.
  • Operational request volume reaching Account Managers drops measurably against the current baseline.
  • Complex issues are resolved inside SLA, with recurring causes identified and at least two fixed at source.
  • Configuration changes are executed without a compliance or limit error.
  • Clients hear about launch-affecting issues from the TAM before they raise them.
  • This full-time position can be a permanent consultant basis for contractors within European Time zone

Founder led. Impact driven. Employee centric.
At Booming Games, we're reshaping the iGaming world with our remote-first approach. Our rhythm? Thrilling slot games with captivating features and stunning designs released every two weeks - no exceptions! Here, it's all about co-ownership and real growth.   • Competitive package
  • Family-friendly policies

  • Knowledge sharing opportunities
  • Dynamic culture surrounded by industry experts

Working across our Tracking and Automated Officiating (T&AO) value stream, you'll influence an engineering organisation of more than 100 people, setting architectural direction, driving innovation and helping solve some of the most complex tracking challenges in sport.

What you'll do

  • Lead software architecture across our tracking, automated officiating and data delivery products.

  • Shape our shared frameworks, libraries and core technology, making pragmatic decisions about reuse, scalability and performance.

  • Represent Tracking within engineering architecture forums across Hawk-Eye and Sony Sports.

 

Drive computer vision innovation

  • Act as the senior technical authority for computer vision across Hawk-Eye's tracking technology.

  • Set the direction for camera calibration, ball tracking, skeletal tracking and machine learning integration.

  • Research and evaluate emerging technologies, building prototypes to turn promising ideas into practical solutions.

  • Help resolve the most complex technical challenges and ensure our technology continues to evolve.

 

Champion modern engineering

  • Lead the adoption of AI-powered development tools, including agentic coding frameworks, LLM orchestration and automated code generation.

  • Establish practical standards for using these technologies within our large C++ and Python codebases.

  • Explore opportunities in generative AI and synthetic data to accelerate research and improve tracking capabilities.

 

Develop engineering capability

  • Coach and mentor Squad Tech Leads and emerging architects.

  • Share expertise through technical talks, tutorials and knowledge-sharing sessions.

  • Support recruitment and technical assessment for computer vision and machine learning roles.

  • Help ensure our ML training and synthetic data infrastructure is operationally sustainable.

 

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone with exceptional expertise in multi-camera computer vision, combined with the software engineering and architectural experience to influence technology at scale.

 

Computer vision expertise

  • Deep knowledge of multi-camera calibration, including intrinsics, extrinsics, distortion models, anti-wobble and bundle adjustment.

  • Strong understanding of triangulation, 3D ball tracking, pose estimation and skeletal tracking.

  • Experience with continuous-time modelling and inverse kinematics.

 

Software engineering and architecture

  • Expert cross-platform C++ development across Windows and Linux, x86 and ARM.

  • Strong experience with CMake, performance profiling and optimisation.

Machine learning and infrastructure

  • Experience with GPU inference technologies such as TensorRT and Triton.

Modern engineering practices

  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and LLM orchestration.

The person we're looking for

You'll be a confident technical leader who can influence decisions across multiple engineering teams, communicate complex ideas clearly and make pragmatic architectural choices.

You'll be comfortable working with senior stakeholders and external technology partners, including Sony, NVIDIA and AWS, as well as sports leagues and federations.

Just as importantly, you'll know when to challenge existing approaches, balance technical ambition with commercial realities and make clear recommendations on priorities, risks and investment.

 

Why join Hawk-Eye?

Our technology is trusted across some of the world's biggest sporting competitions. You'll have the opportunity to:

jobs.title: Staff Engineer / Paris (W/M/X)
jobs.description:
Pioneer of online flash sales since 2001 and key player in European e-commerce, Veepee collaborates with over 7,000 brands to offer highly discounted products available for a limited time. Operating across various sectors, including fashion, home, wine, travel or beauty... Veepee achieved a turnover of 3.3 billion euros incl. VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries.

🎯 Level & Domain

Level:

Staff Engineer is IC4 on our engineering ladder:

  • Has worked as a Senior Developer in at least two product teams. 

  • Turns the tribe’s hardest, ill-framed problems into shipped business value. 

  • Lands in any product fast, de-risks the complex, and raises the bar across teams.

    • The Fastline:

    Each domain has its own Fastline: a small team of Staff Engineers working across all the products of the domain, in a highly agile, commando mode.

    The Fastline is transverse to the domain’s products: it is not attached to one product, but deployed wherever a domain needs senior engineering firepower the most.

    The Fastline takes on three kinds of work:

  • Complex features in existing products: deliver features too risky, cross-cutting or technically hard for a product team to absorb alongside its committed roadmap.

  • Legacy decommissioning: retire legacy systems safely, migrate their capabilities and data, and switch them off for good.

  • IS simplification: reduce the complexity of the tribe’s information system, remove duplication, and make the architecture easier to run and evolve.

    • Fastlines are attached to the Domain Lead, who sets their priorities based on business value, in coordination with the domains’ Lead ITs. Missions are short and outcome-driven: you join a topic, deliver, hand over to the owning product team, and move on to the next one. 


    🎯 TASK

    Strategic & Hard Problems

  • Take on the domain’s most difficult and strategic topics: legacy decommissioning, IS simplification, complex features in existing products.

  • Contribute, with the Architects, to the decommissioning of legacy systems end to end: map dependencies and data flows, design the migration path, run it without business disruption, and switch the legacy off.

  • Drive the simplification of the tribe’s information system: identify redundant components, unnecessary coupling and dead code, and remove them.

  • Deliver complex, cross-cutting features inside existing products, working hand in hand with their product teams.

    • Fast Onboarding & Delivery

  • Land in any product or codebase of the domain and become productive in days, not months.

  • Quickly understand the business context, the architecture, the constraints and the people involved in a topic.

  • Deliver early and often: integrate end to end first, sequence work from most unknown to least worrisome, and show tangible progress quickly.

  • Hand over cleanly to the owning product team: documentation, tests, runbooks and knowledge transfer, so that the team can run what you built.

    • Problem Framing & Business Partnership

  • Take ill-defined, poorly framed problems and turn them into clear, actionable plans.

  • Navigate between tech and business: understand the business stakes, challenge the need with a “how yes” mindset, and propose the simplest solution that delivers the value.

  • Partner with business teams, PMs/POs and Engineering Managers to shape the problem, identify rabbit holes, no-gos and hidden complexity, and agree on scope.

  • Think business value first: explain the value of every technical investment, legacy removal and simplification included.

  • Be the person the business can count on: reliable, transparent on risks, and committed to outcomes.

    • Engineering Excellence & Technical Leadership

  • Own the how end to end: architecture, libraries, data model, implementation, testing and deployment.

  • Write production code: you are hands-on and contribute heavily to the implementation.

  • Make sound technical trade-offs and document key decisions.

  • Raise the bar in the teams you work with: code quality, testing, operability, and AI-first practices.

  • Coach and mentor engineers along the way, and share knowledge across products.

  • Contribute to the domain’s technical vision and target architecture with the Lead IT and the domain’s Architects.

    • Run & Reliability

  • Live by “you build it, you run it”: ship stable, battle-tested software and take ownership of its run until it is handed over.

  • Make migrations and decommissioning safe: rollback plans, monitoring, data reconciliation, progressive switch-over.

  • Step in on critical incidents and complex production problems across the domain when your expertise is needed.

    • AI-First Ways of Working

  • Treat specifications and tests as IP: in an AI era where code is cheap, Veepee’s value moves from code to clear specifications and tests.

  • Use applied AI and prototyping to move faster: understand legacy codebases, generate migrations and tests, explore solutions.

  • Apply a “no roadmap without AI” mindset and spread AI-first practices across the products you work on.


    • 👉 What this role is not
  • Not a manager: you have no direct reports. You lead through expertise, influence and delivery, not hierarchy.

  • Not an ivory-tower architect: you do not draw diagrams and leave. You write code, ship to production and own the outcome.

  • Not attached to a single product: you go wherever the domain needs you most, and you move on once the job is done.

  • Not a spec coder: you do not need a detailed spec to start. A messy, poorly framed problem is your starting point.

  • Not a purely technical expert disconnected from the business: you understand the business, take initiative and drive every topic with a value-first mindset.


    • 👉 Requirements

  • Experience as a Senior Developer (IC3), or equivalent, in at least two product teams, with a strong track record of shipping working, tested software in production on complex systems.

  • Proven experience on hard, high-stakes topics: legacy migration and decommissioning, large refactorings, architecture simplification, or critical features in existing systems.

  • Deep technical expertise: architecture, system design, distributed systems, data modelling, and engineering best practices.

  • Hands-on and fast: able to dive into an unknown codebase and business context and deliver value quickly.

  • Strong business acumen: ability to understand a business domain, its stakes and KPIs, and to build trusted relationships with business teams.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills: comfortable with ambiguity, able to frame an ill-defined problem and find the simplest path to value.

  • High autonomy and ownership: you do not need to be told what to do, and you take full accountability for outcomes.

  • Hands-on with the “you build it, you run it” principle: operability, monitoring, on-call and SLAs.

  • Pragmatic understanding of applied AI and AI-first engineering (prototyping / vibe coding, AI-assisted legacy understanding, specifications and tests as IP).

  • Ability to influence without authority, and to coach and raise the level of the engineers around you.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration with PMs/POs, Engineering Managers, business teams, engineers, Architects, SREs, the Lead IT and the Domain Lead.

  • Open to internal Senior Developers (IC3) who meet these criteria, as well as external applications.

  • Master’s degree in Engineering / IT or equivalent.

  • Fluency in English, international environment.


    • ✅ BENEFITS
  • Variable bonus
  • Profit-sharing and incentive schemes
  • Remote work possible for up to 2 days per week

  • Works Council (CSE) with a wide range of benefits

jobs.description:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Audit Senior Specialist

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

About the role

You will be the statutory Head of Internal Audit for Nubank's European entity and the primary Internal Audit point of contact for the local regulator. As Nubank builds its regulated European operation, independent assurance is what earns and keeps the trust of the regulator and the governance bodies — you own that from day one.

This is not a role that supervises other people doing the work. It is a full hands-on, build-from-scratch role: for the first 12–18 months you will operate largely on your own, performing and leading the audits yourself, with the support of Nubank's global Internal Audit team and additional resources over time as the function matures. You'll report functionally into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership, preserving Internal Audit's independence and maintaining direct access to the entity's Audit and Risk Committees.

You will build a modern, data-driven audit function — one that leans on automation, analytics and AI rather than traditional checklist auditing — while partnering with a young, fast-scaling business where governance and controls are still being built. Your goal: stand up and run a credible Internal Audit function that gives the Committees and the local regulator confidence that Nubank is growing in a healthy, sustainable way.

You'll be responsible for

  • Acting as the statutory Head of Internal Audit for the European entity, representing Internal Audit before the local regulator and reporting independently into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership and the relevant Committees.

  • Owning the entity's Internal Audit universe and risk assessment — a dynamic view of key risks across products, digital asset initiatives, financial crime, governance and internal-control frameworks.

  • Designing and executing the audit plan, and coordinating closely with Nubank's global Internal Audit function and the hubs in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia.

  • Performing and leading end-to-end audits hands-on — not only scoping and coordinating fieldwork, but often running the testing yourself — covering fintech/digital banking products, digital assets and related infrastructure, AML/financial-crime obligations, and governance, risk and control frameworks.

  • Coordinating Internal Audit's contribution to supervisory interactions with the local regulator, being comfortable explaining clearly what Internal Audit does before any regulator, and proactively communicating emerging risks.

  • Engaging the governance bodies — Audit Committee and Risk Committee — with clear, concise, impact-oriented reporting.

  • Building trust-based relationships with local senior management and second-line risk/compliance partners, operating as a trusted challenger and advisor while preserving Internal Audit's independence.

  • Promoting the use of technology, data and AI in the audit work — continuous auditing routines, data analytics, AI-assisted testing and documentation — to increase coverage and enable predictive risk monitoring.

  • Acting as a culture carrier for Nubank's Internal Audit, keeping the local function fully integrated into the global audit vision and standards.

  • Over time, and consistent with business and regulatory needs, designing, building and leading an appropriately resourced Internal Audit function for the entity.

We are looking for a person who has

Experience and background

  • A solid Internal Audit background in financial services (as an internal or external auditor); senior second-line/compliance profiles are welcome when grounded in prior Internal Audit experience.

  • Experience with the Swiss or European regulatory framework.

  • Meaningful experience in fintech or banking.

  • Experience engaging governance bodies, specifically Audit and Risk Committees.

  • Proven knowledge of fintech/digital-banking business models, AML/financial-crime controls and investigations, and traditional banking products and infrastructure.

Ways of working and skills

  • High ownership and autonomy

  • A genuinely hands-on posture

  • A builder mindset

  • A data-driven approach to audit: experience with data and analytics in audit or risk work; hands-on SQL/Python is a strong plus and a good signal of fit, and a strong appetite to work with data-driven testing is essential.

Cultural openness and humility

  • Ability to analyze end-to-end processes and controls across finance, credit, payments, AML, information security, technology and governance, connecting the details to the overall risk profile.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, explaining complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including regulators and senior executives.

  • Strong stakeholder management — influencing senior leaders, challenging constructively and building trust across the three lines of defense.

  • German is required — the local regulator operates in German and there is no intermediary for regulatory interaction, so working proficiency in German is needed. Fluent English is also required.

Nice to have

  • Experience with digital assets — crypto and stablecoins. (Digital-assets experience is a plus, not a requirement)

  • No specific certification is required (CIA, ACCA, CISA, etc. are welcome but not mandatory).

Location for this opportunity

  • Zug, Switzerland

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Health Insurance Allowance for you and your dependents

  • Pension Plan

  • Accident Insurance

  • Daily Sickness Benefits

  • Life Insurance & Death Benefits

  • NuCare – Employee Assistance Programme, available 24/7 for you and your dependents

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • International Travel Insurance for business trips

  • Work-from-home Allowance and office equipment for working from home

  • Parking space at the Zug office

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Who are we?

We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth.
